I'm sorry to say this when you're working so hard to help us, but how about searching for some other work? I think It's a shame to let your skills go to waste.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
很抱歉在您這麼努力幫助我們的時候說這些，但您不妨去找找其他工作？我覺得讓您的技能被浪費掉太可惜了。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that honey collect is in need of help, so you should go see ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我聽說蜂蜜採集需要人手，您可以去見見^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000。感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我聽說普羅克現在需要幫忙。您不妨去見見^4D4DFF[普羅克]^000000？感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
說到這個，^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000說他也需要幫忙。您願意試試嗎？感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
住在蝮蛇洞穴入口處的^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000正在急切地尋找強者。也許您可以去試試，當作積累經驗。感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船去尋找更大的冒險，也是個不錯的選擇。感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Thank you. Now our cows can enjoy delicious meal.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
謝謝。現在我們的奶牛可以享用美味的大餐了。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
But you seem too skilled to do this kind of work. There are many other jobs that require physical strength, so perhaps you should go seek them.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
但您看起來太熟練了，不適合做這種工作。有很多其他需要體力的工作，也許您應該去尋求那些機會。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Not today. Maybe tomorrow? Let me see... Who said needed some help?
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
今天不行。也許明天？讓我想想... 誰說過需要幫忙來著？

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that honey collect is in need of help, so you should go see ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我聽說蜂蜜採集需要人手，您可以去見見^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000。感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我聽說普羅克現在需要幫忙。您不妨去見見^4D4DFF[普羅克]^000000？感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
說到這個，^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000說他也需要幫忙。您願意試試嗎？感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
住在蝮蛇洞穴入口處的^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000正在急切地尋找強者。也許您可以去試試，當作積累經驗。感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船去尋找更大的冒險，也是個不錯的選擇。感謝您幫助我們。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Hey cows- eat a lot and relax a lot- I'll sing you a song-
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
嘿，奶牛們——多吃多休息——我來給你們唱首歌——

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Hello, are you the person who's here to help us? Then you can start now.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
你好，你是來幫助我們的人嗎？那麼你可以現在開始了。

scripts.text: What is going on?
scripts.translation: 發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: I'm not working.
scripts.translation: 我沒在工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Work? That's out of the blue. No, I won't do it!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
工作？這真是突然。不，我不幹！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you need help, then you should at least tell me what I should do.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你需要幫忙，至少該告訴我該做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Oh, didn't the Chef tell you? I'm sorry, most people come here after hearing the details from him.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
哦，廚師沒告訴你嗎？抱歉，大多數人都是聽了他說的詳情後才來的。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Those Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are eating away the entire grass. But they shouldn't because they're leaving my cute cows here with no food.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
那些草地綠棉蟲和群葉瘋兔正在吃光所有的草。但它們不該這樣，因為它們留在這裡讓我的可愛奶牛們沒東西吃。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Our cows have nothing to eat then.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我們的奶牛沒東西吃了。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
If our cows can't eat grass, then we can't milk them. If we have no fresh milk, then we can't make kaluna milk.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
如果我們的奶牛吃不到草，我們就無法擠奶。如果沒有新鮮牛奶，我們就無法制作卡魯納牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
And... Oh, I don't even want to imagine after that.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
而且...唉，我甚至不敢想像之後會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
So I need you to catch Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics. Five each. Okay, then start!
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
所以，我需要你捕捉草地綠棉蟲和群葉瘋兔。各五隻。好的，開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
You're still not done yet. Please catch five Grass Fabres and five Leaf Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
你還沒完成呢。請捕捉五隻草地綠棉蟲和五隻群葉瘋兔。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Mm...good. This area is settled now. You're really good at this.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
嗯...很好。這一帶現在安全了。你真的很擅長這個。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Thank you so much. I hope you can help us again next time. So what'd you say? Please give it a thought.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
非常感謝。希望下次還能得到你的幫助。那麼，你剛才說的是什麼？請再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
there's nothing threatening around here right now. Our cows are satisfied with their meals, too.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
目前這一帶沒有威脅。我們的奶牛也吃得飽飽的。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Get some good rest and come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
好好休息，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Adventurer, please help! Packs of Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are coming this way!
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
冒險者，請幫幫忙！成群的草地綠棉蟲和群葉瘋兔正朝這邊衝過來！

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Please catch five from each pack! I'll do whatever I can with the rest!
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
請從每群中捕捉五隻！剩下的我會盡力處理！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Adventurer, I know you're helping us right now but I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
冒險者，我知道你現在正在幫我們，但我認為你更適合去別的領域工作，而不是在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我聽說普羅克現在需要幫忙。你不妨去見見^4D4DFF[普羅克]^000000？謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
說到這個，^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000說他也需要幫忙。你想試試嗎？謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
住在蛇蜥洞穴入口的^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000正在急切地尋找強者。也許你可以去試試，順便練練級。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船去尋找更大的冒險，也是個不錯的主意。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Thanks to you, we were able to collect so much honey. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
多虧了你，我們收集到了很多蜂蜜。謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
But I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
但我認為你更適合去別的領域工作，而不是在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
If It's all right with you, may I find you work? You've done a lot today, so please get some good rest and see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
如果你不介意的話，我可以給你找點工作嗎？你今天已經做了很多了，請好好休息，明天見。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我聽說普羅克現在需要幫忙。你不妨去見見^4D4DFF[普羅克]^000000？謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
說到這個，^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000說他也需要幫忙。你想試試嗎？謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
住在蛇蜥洞穴入口的^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000正在急切地尋找強者。也許你可以去試試，順便練練級。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船去尋找更大的冒險，也是個不錯的主意。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I really like this job! I can smell sweet flowers and also get some honey!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我真的很喜歡這份工作！既能聞到甜甜的花香，又能採到蜂蜜！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
You're not taking my honey!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
你休想搶走我的蜂蜜！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ouch! Why are you hitting me all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎喲！你幹嘛突然打我？

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Oh! I'm sorry. I thought it was the hornets again.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
啊！對不起。我以為是蜂兵又來了。

scripts.text: You look like you need help.
scripts.translation: 你看起來需要幫忙

scripts.text: Be careful next time.
scripts.translation: 下次小心點

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I almost got hurt. Please be careful next time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我差點受傷了。下次請小心點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You look like you need help. Want me to help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起來需要幫忙。要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Really... you'll help me? Even after I had hit you? Well, I'm so grateful if you can because I need some help right now.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
真的...你會幫我嗎？就算我剛才打了你？既然你願意，那我太感激了，因為我現在確實需要幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I'm collecting honey needed to ferment kaluna from the blooming flowers here, but our biggest rivals, the hornets, are taking everything before we even get a chance.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我正在採集釀造卡魯納所需的蜂蜜，但我們的最大對手蜂兵總是搶先一步，讓我們根本採不到。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
At this rate, I won't have enough honey and won't be able to make kaluna milk. If people can't drink kaluna milk, then there will be a riot and...
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
照這樣下去，我採不到足夠的蜂蜜，就做不出卡魯納牛奶了。如果人們喝不到卡魯納牛奶，就會發生暴動...

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Adventurer, I beg you. We must stop Lasagna from going back to its dark ages. Everything is in your hands!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
冒險者，求求你了。我們必須阻止羅札納回到黑暗時代。一切就拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Please defeat our rivals, the wild hornets. Around ten would do.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
請擊敗我們的對手，狂野蜂兵。大概需要十隻。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
If you can defeat them, then I'll do whatever I can with the rest. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
如果你能擊敗它們，剩下的交給我處理就好。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Oh, you're not done yet. Have you forgotten what you were supposed to catch?
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
哦，你還沒做完呢。忘了你要抓什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Florin]
You need to catch ten wild hornets. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
你需要抓十隻狂野蜂兵。祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Thanks to you, we were able to collect so much honey. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
多虧了你，我們收集到了很多蜂蜜。謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
But I think you are better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
但我認為你更適合去別的領域工作，而不是在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
If It's all right with you, may I find you work? You've done a lot today, so please get some good rest and see you tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
如果你不介意的話，我可以給你找點工作嗎？你今天已經做了很多了，請好好休息，明天見。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I heard that Prok needs some help right now. Why don't you go see ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
我聽說普羅克現在需要幫忙。你不妨去見見^4D4DFF[普羅克]^000000？謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
The wild hornets are quiet right now. At this number, I can take care of them myself.
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
現在狂野蜂兵很安靜。就這個數量，我自己能應付。

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Once the sun is up, they'll be back again. Could you come back then and help me?
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
太陽昇起後，它們就會回來。到時候你能再來幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nedsoli]
You look like you still need help today as well. Want me to help?
scripts.translation:
[內德索利]
你看起來今天還是需要幫忙。要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Florin]
Ah, adventurer, I'm so glad you're here!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
啊，冒險者，你來了真好！

scripts.text:
[Florin]
I need you to defeat our rival wild hornet today as well. Around ten hornets. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[弗洛林]
今天也需要你擊敗我們的對手狂野蜂兵。大概十隻。謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Prok]
After observing you, I get a feeling that you might better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
觀察了你之後，我覺得你或許不適合這個領域，換個領域發展會更好。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
說到這個，^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000說他需要幫忙。你要不要試試？謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有巴希利斯克的洞穴入口附近，它正在尋找強大的個體。為了積累經驗，你不妨去試試。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船去尋找更大的冒險，也是個不錯的選擇。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
After observing you, I get a feeling that you might better off working not in this field, but in a different one.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
觀察了你之後，我覺得你或許不適合這個領域，換個領域發展會更好。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
說到這個，^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000說他需要幫忙。你要不要試試？謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有巴希利斯克的洞穴入口附近，它正在尋找強大的個體。為了積累經驗，你不妨去試試。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船去尋找更大的冒險，也是個不錯的選擇。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Wow, thank you! That was quick.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
哇，謝謝你！動作真快。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
But rather than working on this side, I think you should seek out for an adventure.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
不過，我覺得與其在這裡工作，不如去尋求冒險。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
If you wish, I can find something for you. But not today. Perhaps tomorrow. Today you should get some rest.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
如果你願意，我可以幫你找點事做。但不是今天，也許是明天。今天你應該好好休息。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Speaking of which, ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 said he needed some help. Would you like to give it a try? Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
說到這個，^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000說他需要幫忙。你要不要試試？謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有巴希利斯克的洞穴入口附近，它正在尋找強大的個體。為了積累經驗，你不妨去試試。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船去尋找更大的冒險，也是個不錯的選擇。謝謝你幫我們的忙。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Slippery- sticky- It's amazing such creatures exist.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
滑溜溜的...粘糊糊的...真不敢相信竟然存在這樣的生物。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Can you by any chance help me? If you have time, that is.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
如果你有空的話，能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text: I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 我來幫你。

scripts.text: I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm busy right now. I'll help you next time. Sorry!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在很忙。下次再幫你吧。抱歉！

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Wow! Thank you! I need to take sticky webfeet but That's a bit hard to do alone.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
哇！謝謝你！我需要粘糊的蹼，但這一個人很難做到。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
This sticky webfoot is the main ingredient of pudding, but it goes bad quickly after a day. And smells awful, too.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
粘糊的蹼是布丁的主要原料，但放一天就會變質。而且味道很難聞。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
So every day, I must only collect how much I need for the day. But I still haven't collected enough for today.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
所以每天我只能採集當天需要的量。但我今天還沒采集夠。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Chef must be waiting... It's such a relief that you're helping me.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
廚師肯定在等著...幸好你願意幫我。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Could you catch Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me sticky webfeet? Around five of them. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
你能捕捉甜心羅達蛙並給我粘糊的蹼嗎？大概五隻。謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Um, did you really catch Sweet Roda Frog?
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
嗯，你真的捕捉了甜心羅達蛙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prok]
You need to catch ten... I also need five sticky webfeet.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
你需要捕捉十隻...我也需要五隻粘糊的蹼。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
I asked for five sticky webfeet but I still need a bit more. I don't have enough time to collect them alone.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
我要了五隻粘糊的蹼，但還是不夠。我沒有時間一個人去採集。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Wow, thank you! That was quick.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
哇，謝謝你！動作真快。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can I ask for a favor again next time? I need to take fresh ones every day.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
下次我還能再麻煩你嗎？我每天都要新鮮的。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
You're here again. But I don't need sticky webfeet yet. What you sent yesterday is enough.
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
你又來了。但我現在不需要粘糊的蹼。你昨天送來的已經夠了。

scripts.text:
[Prok]
But you never know, so can you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
不過世事難料，你明天能再來一趟嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prok]
You're here. Can you help me today as well?
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
你來了。今天也能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Prok]
Could you catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me sticky webfeet? Around five of them. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[普羅克]
能幫我抓十隻甜心羅達蛙，帶些粘糊的蹼來嗎？大概五隻左右。謝謝！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Adventurer, stop what you're doing just for a minute. I think I can handle it alone from here. You seem too strong for this type of work, you know.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
冒險者，請停下手中的事聽我說。我覺得剩下的我自己能搞定。你的實力太強了，做這種工作有點大材小用。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有蠑螈出沒的洞穴入口附近，它正在尋找強者。也許你可以去試試，就當是積累經驗了。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船出發，去尋找更大的冒險，這也是個好主意。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Thank you so much. I bet they'll be scared to show up for a while.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
非常感謝。我想它們短時間內不敢再來了。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
But I think you should seek for bigger adventures. don't let your skills go to waste in this boondocks and go out to a bigger place.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
不過我覺得你應該去尋找更大的冒險。別讓你的技藝荒廢在這偏僻之地，去更廣闊的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Right. There was someone who needed help. You had a long day today, so perhaps you should go see him tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
沒錯。之前有人需要幫忙。你今天辛苦了，也許明天再去看看他比較好。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000, who lives over there at the mouth of the cave where basilisks live, is desperately seeking for a strong individual. Perhaps you should give it a try for the experience. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000住在有蠑螈出沒的洞穴入口附近，它正在尋找強者。也許你可以去試試，就當是積累經驗了。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Taking a ship from the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 in search of a bigger adventure is also a good idea. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
從^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000乘船出發，去尋找更大的冒險，這也是個好主意。謝謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Today's wind is good! The fish will dry nicely.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
今天的風不錯！魚乾能曬得很好。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Oh, what am I going to do. Hey you, adventurer! Hold on a second!
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
哎呀，這可怎麼辦。喂，冒險者！等一下！

scripts.text: What's up?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text: I'm busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Yeah? Then I guess there's nothing I can do.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
是嗎？那我也沒辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Take a look at those Desert Wolves. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
看看那些沙漠之狼。你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Those monsters steal all the fish I'm drying right now!
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
那些魔物偷走了我正在晾曬的魚！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
What Hunter Desert Wolf in the world eats fish? A dried one, too!
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
哪有沙漠之狼吃魚的？還是吃魚乾！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Then again...It's hard to forget this fish once you get a taste of it since the flavors are concentrated.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
不過話說回來...這種魚味道濃郁，一旦嘗過就很難忘記。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
But this is Chef's favorite snack. It's the only snack that picky eater likes.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
但這是廚師最喜歡的零食。它是挑食者唯一喜歡的零食。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Without it, we have to endure a very difficult time.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
沒有它，我們要度過非常艱難的日子。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Oh, there they are again! Adventurer, please keep them from coming here. Catch ten of them.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
哦，它們又來了！冒險者，請阻止它們再來這裡。抓十隻。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Those Hunter Desert Wolves are rampaging still.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
那些沙漠之狼還在肆虐。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
At least ten should be caught.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
至少要抓十隻。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Adventurer, I was so desperate back then that I just grabbed anybody who passed by, but I think I hit the jackpot!
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
冒險者，當時我走投無路，隨便拉了個路人幫忙，沒想到真是撿到寶了！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Oh, don't take it the wrong way. Despite what it may seem, I'm really grateful from deep down. Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
哦，別誤會。雖然看起來可能不像，但我發自內心地感激你。謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
I hope you can help me tomorrow as well!
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
希望明天也能得到你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
The Hunter Desert Wolves are quiet right now. They must've been shocked to see you in action.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
獵人沙漠狼現在安靜多了。它們看到你出手的樣子，肯定嚇壞了。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
So I hope you come back tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
所以希望明天你還能來！

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Adventurer, good to see you! They're fiercely coming at us. I guess they're real furious about not having any fish yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
冒險者，見到你真好！它們正凶猛地衝過來。看來它們對昨天沒吃到魚的事非常生氣。

scripts.text:
[Fisher]
Whoa! There they are again! Adventure, please keep those Hunter Desert Wolves away from here. Catch ten of them.
scripts.translation:
[漁夫]
哇！它們又來了！冒險者，請把這些獵人沙漠狼趕遠點。抓十隻。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Don't block the sunlight meow...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
別擋住陽光喵...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer. I had a dream. You were heading off to the new world meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒險者。我做了一個夢。夢裡你正前往新世界喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
My dream is almost prophetic. So stop what you were doing and go to the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 to board on a ship heading to the new world. A bigger adventure will be waiting for you there meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我的夢通常都很準。所以停下你手頭的事，去^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000登上前往新世界的船吧。那裡會有更大的冒險在等著你喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Wherever go you, I wish you well. Thank you meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
無論你去哪裡，我都祝你一切順利。謝謝你喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer. I had a dream. You were heading off to the new world meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒險者。我做了一個夢。夢裡你正前往新世界喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
My dream is almost prophetic. So stop what you were doing and go to the ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 to board on a ship heading to the new world. A bigger adventure will be waiting for you there meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我的夢通常都很準。所以停下你手頭的事，去^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000登上前往新世界的船吧。那裡會有更大的冒險在等著你喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Wherever go you, I wish you well. Thank you meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
無論你去哪裡，我都祝你一切順利。謝謝你喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer. You're kind... You saved my life.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒險者。你真好...你救了我的命。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
But what are you doing in such a rustic place? Isn't it better that you go and search for a bigger world? Like the new world, for example.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
但你為什麼待在這種偏僻的地方？去探索更廣闊的世界不是更好嗎？比如新世界。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
If I were you, I would've left long ago. You're not here because you don't know how to get there, right? If That's the case, then I'll tell you. I can do that much for my life's savior.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
如果是我的話，早就離開了。你留在這裡，是因為不知道怎麼去那裡，對吧？如果是這樣，我就告訴你吧。作為救命恩人，這點忙我還是可以幫的。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
If you go to Lasagna, there is a ^4D4DFF[dock]^000000 there. Take a ship that goes to the new world from there. Wherever you go, I wish you the best. Thanks for everything meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
如果你去羅札納，那裡有一個^4D4DFF[碼頭]^000000。從那裡坐船去新世界吧。無論你去哪裡，我都祝你一切順利。謝謝你的救命之恩喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer...please save me...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒險者...請救救我...

scripts.text: Why? What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？怎麼了？

scripts.text: What do you mean, save you?
scripts.translation: 你說救你？是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think someone with more experience should take care of this. I'm still a rookie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我覺得應該讓更有經驗的人來處理這件事。我還是個新人。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
So cold-hearted...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
好冷酷無情...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I think I'm going to die at this rate...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
照這樣下去，我好像要死了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
My dad, I mean, Chef, told me to get mushroom spores or something...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我爸爸，我是說廚師，讓我去採香菇芽孢什麼的...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
But look. The sunlight.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
但是你看。陽光。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I must bathe in the sunlight and sleep on days like this...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
在這樣的日子裡，我必須沐浴在陽光下睡覺...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
This sunlight is putting me to sleep meow...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
這陽光讓我好睏喵...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I was here, desperately fighting against the sunlight and waiting for someone to pass by meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我就在這裡，拼命抵抗陽光，等著有人經過喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I think I'm going to die, trying to fight sleepiness meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我覺得我要死了，因為我在和睏意作鬥爭喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
So please get those mushroom spores for me cuz I'm dying meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
所以請幫我採那些香菇芽孢，因為我快死了喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
And while you're at it, beat those Trans Spores, too. I hate them meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
順便把那些變形蘑菇也打了吧。我討厭它們喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
My dad, I mean, Chef, gave me a training on entering caves so he can use me for such tasks meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
我爸爸，我是說廚師，訓練我進入洞穴，這樣他就可以讓我做這種任務喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
So just the thought of them makes me all furious meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
所以光是想到它們我就很生氣喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
What is that look in your eyes? Do you think I'm pathetic meow?
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
你那個眼神是什麼意思？你覺得我很可憐喵？

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
That's rude but It's okay. You're not the only one meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
這很無禮，但沒關係。你不是唯一一個這樣想的人喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
It's okay if you decide not to help meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
如果你決定不幫我，也沒關係喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Even if I don't die here fighting against sleep, my dad, I mean, Chef, will kill me. Merely over mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
即使我不是在這裡因睏倦而死，我爸爸，我是說廚師，也會殺了我。僅僅因為香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
That's okay, too. I came back to life many times already. Long and deep sleep is all I need to revive meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
那也沒關係。我已經復活過很多次了。只要睡個長覺就能復活喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
So, please think of it as... saving someone's life...and help meeee...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
所以，請把它當作...救一個人的命...幫幫我吧...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Adventurer...? Are you waking me up cuz you're done? Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒險者...？你是因為做完了才把我叫醒的嗎？讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Wow, you're really done! That was so quick of you that I am wide awake. You really are a wonder!
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
哇，你真的做完了！你做得太快了，我現在都完全清醒了。你真是不可思議！

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Why don't you work at Pub-Oven instead of me? Then again, I'm sure you'd hate that, too.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
你為什麼不乾脆去Pub-Oven工作，而不是幫我呢？不過話說回來，我相信你也會討厭那裡的。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
I might need to get some mushroom spores or something tomorrow as well, so drop by again. I'm going to bring these quickly and relax. Thanks! I owe you.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
明天我可能還需要一些香菇芽孢之類的，所以請再來一趟。我要趕緊把這些送出去，然後休息一下。謝謝！我欠你一個人情。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Have you finished it already meow?
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
你已經做完了嗎喵？

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Of course not. This is not it. Did you forget already meow?
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
當然沒有。這不是那個任務。你已經忘記了嗎喵？

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Catch ten Trans Spores and bring five mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
捕捉十隻變形蘑菇，並帶給我五個香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Call me when you're done. Don't wake me up for no reason meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
做完之後叫我。不要無緣無故叫醒我喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
there's no more for today, so can go...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
今天沒有更多工了，你可以走了...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
don't disturb my... sleep...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
別打擾我的...睡眠...

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
An adventurer. The adventurer from yesterday. Great, please save me today as well meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
冒險者。昨天那位冒險者。太好了，請今天也救救我喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
There seems to be another bothersome fish cake order that came in. So please get the ingredients for me. I'm busy today as well, desperately fighting against the sunlight meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
似乎又有一單麻煩的魚糕訂單進來了。所以請幫我準備食材。我今天也很忙，正在拼命抵抗陽光喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Catch ten Trans Spores and bring them five mushroom spores meow.
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
捕捉十隻變形蘑菇，並帶給我五個香菇芽孢喵。

scripts.text:
[Sleepy meow]
Please...help me...
scripts.translation:
[瞌睡喵]
請...幫幫我...

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You finished the job safe and sound. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你安全順利地完成了工作。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But you're still skilled to be stuck here working. How about you look for something else?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
但以你的技術，還留在這裡工作未免太屈才了。不如去找點別的做？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Going on an adventure to the new world would be nice, too. If it weren't for my job, I would've left long ago.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
去新世界冒險也不錯。要不是因為這份工作，我早就離開了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Anyway, thanks for your help. It helped a lot.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
總之，謝謝你的幫忙。幫了大忙了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I see that you were taking care of the favor I had asked.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
看來你一直在處理我拜託你的事情。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But you're still skilled to be stuck here working. How about you look for something else?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
但以你的技術，還留在這裡工作未免太屈才了。不如去找點別的做？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I am not shameless enough to tie down a young person with such potential.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我還沒有厚顏到要用這種潛力無限的人來束縛自己。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Going on an adventure to the new world would be nice, too. If it weren't for my job, I would've left long ago.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
去新世界冒險也不錯。要不是因為這份工作，我早就離開了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Anyway, thanks for your help. It helped a lot.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
總之，謝謝你的幫忙。幫了大忙了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I'm busy! So busy!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我很忙！非常忙！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Adventurer, can you do me a small favor? There are things I must do right now but as you can see, I am shorthanded. What'd you say?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
冒險者，能幫我個小忙嗎？我現在手頭有急事，但你也看到了，我人手不足。你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Think of it as a continuation of your training and please help me. I'll give you a hefty wage, so what'd you say?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
就當是繼續你的訓練吧，請幫幫我。我會給你豐厚的報酬，你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: I'll give it a try.
scripts.translation: 我試試看。

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm busy right now. I'll do it later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在很忙。稍後再說。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Oh, thanks a bunch. What a relief, really!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
哦，太感謝了。真是幫了大忙！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Then Let's cut to the chase.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
那我們長話短說吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
All people from Lasagna love kaluna milk, but do you know what It's made of? Kaluna made from well-fermented kalunyak and fresh milk.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
羅札納的人都喜歡卡魯納牛奶，但你知道它是怎麼做的嗎？是用發酵良好的卡魯尼亞克和新鮮牛奶製成的卡魯納。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Do you know what the important things are when making kaluna milk? They're well-fermented kaluna and fresh milk.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你知道製作卡魯納牛奶最重要的東西是什麼嗎？是發酵良好的卡魯尼亞克和新鮮牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I beg you. Please catch Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet! Without them, I can't make any pudding!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
拜託了。請去抓羅達蛙，給我帶五隻粘粘的腳掌！沒有它們，我就做不了布丁了！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
My strings still Aren't here. It must be those Desert Wolves again.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我的線還沒到。肯定是那些沙漠狼又搞的鬼。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Do you know what Pub-Oven's signature menu is?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你知道Pub-Oven的招牌菜是什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Our cow...should eat lots of tasty stuff... Please take care of five Leaf Lunatics and five Grass Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們的奶牛...應該多吃點好吃的...請幫我處理五隻群葉瘋兔和五隻草地綠棉蟲。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
You must hurry. We're almost done with the honey we have. Ten wild hornets!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你得快點。我們的蜂蜜快用完了。十隻狂野蜂兵！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Please help me make some pudding today. Catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請幫我今天做點布丁。抓十隻甜心羅達蛙，給我帶五隻粘粘的腳掌！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Please guard my strings. Catch ten Hunter Desert Wolves. That should be enough to keep them away from my strings.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請幫我看守我的線。抓十隻獵人沙漠狼。那樣應該就足夠讓它們遠離我的線了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Can we make some fish cake today? I beg you. Please don't make me send my customers home empty handed. They came after a long time for fish cakes.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們今天能做點魚糕嗎？拜託了。請別讓我讓顧客空手而歸。他們等了很久才來吃魚糕。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Now our cows can have lots of tasty grasses. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
現在我們的奶牛可以吃到很多好吃的草了。謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
You took care of those wild hornets safely. Just amazing.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你安全地處理了那些狂野蜂兵。真了不起。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Five sticky webfeet. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
五隻粘粘的腳掌。完美。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Adventurer, I heard about your feats. Thanks to you, my strings are safe.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
冒險者，我聽說你的壯舉了。多虧了你，我的線很安全。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
Five mushroom spores. Perfect. It was wise to ask an adventurer for help.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
五朵香菇芽孢。完美。
向冒險者求助真是明智之舉。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
[Chef]
What, you're here already to help?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
什麼，你已經來幫忙了？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
As the recipe is simple, it takes good ingredients to come up with the best taste. So we get milk from our own cow that we raised.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
雖然食譜很簡單，但要做出最好的味道，就需要優質的食材。
所以我們用自家養的奶牛來產奶。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I'm sure you've been to Raviol Plains. You must come from there.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我相信你肯定去過羅札納平原。
你一定是從那裡來的。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Where you must go is not the guard post. If you go south straight down, you'll see crossroads. Then go straight down underneath.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你要去的地方不是衛兵哨所。
一直往南走，你會看到十字路口。
然後繼續直走，往下走。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
That's where our cows are grazing. Grass there is fresh and clean, so the milk tastes superb.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們的奶牛就在那裡吃草。
那裡的草新鮮又幹淨，所以牛奶味道極佳。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But the Grass Fabres and Leaf Lunatics are devouring the grasses.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
但是草地綠棉蟲和群葉瘋兔正在吃光那些草。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So please go and get rid of them. Five from each group should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
所以請去把它們趕走。
每種各抓五隻應該就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me after catching all of them, or you can talk to the ^4D4DFF[shepherd]^000000 there.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
抓完所有之後你可以來找我，
也可以去那裡找^4D4DFF[牧羊人]^000000。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Pay is same anywhere. You ready?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
無論在哪裡，報酬都是一樣的。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Kaluna is made by a kaluna master near the south bridge. I can't tell you what exactly goes in there because It's a trade secret, but I can tell you one thing.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
卡魯納是由南橋附近的一位卡魯納大師製作的。
我不能告訴你裡面具體放了什麼，因為那是商業機密，但我可以告訴你一件事。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
It's honey. Lasagna fields are covered with sweet flowers, so we can collect a lot of quality honey.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
是蜂蜜。羅札納平原上開滿了甜甜的花，
所以我們可以採集到很多優質蜂蜜。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But do you know what the greatest enemy is when collecting that honey? It's the wild hornet.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
但你知道採集蜂蜜時最大的敵人是什麼嗎？
是狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
They're honey-crazy creatures who are masters when it comes to collecting honey... We can't get rid of them entirely since the flowers need to be pollenated, but there's a need to control their number.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
它們是痴迷於蜂蜜的生物，在採集蜂蜜方面也是行家...
既然花朵需要授粉，我們無法徹底消滅它們，
但必須控制它們的數量。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So when the time comes, we hire adventurers to hunt the wild hornets.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
所以到了時候，我們會僱傭冒險者去獵殺狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You should give it a try. Ten hornets Aren't too much of a burden.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你應該試一試。
十隻蜂兵不算太重的負擔。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000 who is collecting honey there.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
完成後你可以來找我，
或者去那裡向正在採蜜的^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000彙報。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I beg you, please.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
拜託了，求你了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please catch ten Roda Frogs. I always hated their slippery skin.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請抓十隻羅達蛙。
我一直討厭它們滑溜溜的皮膚。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may bring sticky webfeet to me if you get them, or you may take them to ^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000. He agreed to bring them here anyway.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
如果你能抓到粘粘的腳掌，可以帶給我，
也可以交給^4D4DFF[普羅克]^000000。反正他也答應會帶過來的。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Hey adventurer, so what'd you say? won't you take care of those wolves and save our strings?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
嘿，冒險者，你剛才說什麼來著？
難道你不願意趕走那些狼，救救我們的魚串嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are the strings?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
魚串是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Dried fish. They are tied one after the other on a string, so we call them strings for short. But those Desert Wolves are a headache because they constantly finish them off.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
就是曬乾的魚。它們被一根接一根地串在繩子上，所以我們簡稱它們為“魚串”。
但那些沙漠狼真是讓人頭疼，總是把它們吃光。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please take care of those Desert Wolves and save our strings. They're my favorite snack. Catch ten wolves and they won't come near anymore.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請趕走那些沙漠狼，救救我們的魚串吧。
那是我最喜歡的零食。只要抓十隻狼，它們就不會再靠近了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to ^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000 who is drying fish there.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
完成後你可以來找我，
或者去那裡向正在曬魚的^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000彙報。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kaluna milk?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
卡魯納牛奶？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
No, no. That's the most popular menu. What I mean is... right! Chef's specialty menu is what I meant.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
不不不，那是最暢銷的菜品。
我的意思是...對了！我是說廚師的招牌菜。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
It's the fish cake, there Aren't too many who ask for it. So we don't even have the ingredients in store.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
就是魚糕，點它的人不多。
所以我們甚至沒有備貨。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So we get the ingredients immediately when there's an order.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
所以一旦有訂單，我們會立刻去採購食材。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Pub-Oven has its own special network where it receives ingredients within ten minutes. So customers don't need to wait infinitely.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
“Pub-Oven”有自己特殊的配送網路，能在十分鐘內收到食材。
所以顧客不需要無限期地等待。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But as you know, there's no such thing as ����never���� in life. Yet, we always make the effort to achieve ����never.����
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
但正如你所知，生活中沒有“永不”這回事。
然而，我們總是努力追求“永不”。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
And right now, that effort is being challenged.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
而此刻，這種努力正受到挑戰。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You must've heard about the cave in Raviol Forest. There are unspeakable things as well as creatures that are delicious food ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你一定聽說過拉維奧森林裡的洞穴吧。
那裡不僅有不可名狀的東西，還有美味的食材生物。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You know the Trans Spores? Their ����mushroom spores���� are an essential ingredient for our fish cake.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你知道變形蘑菇嗎？它們的“香菇芽孢”是我們製作魚糕的必要食材。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
But for some reason, they live with the basilisks, but so this is a serious problem for us.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
但不知為何，它們和石像鬼住在一起，這對我們來說是個嚴重的問題。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
We sent someone in a hurry to find some mushroom spores, but nothing. No news at all.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們匆忙派人去找香菇芽孢，但一無所獲。
完全沒有訊息。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
It's been 15 minutes since we sent a message but still no news. This must mean that he's probably sleeping nearby again.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
發訊息已經15分鐘了，還是沒訊息。
這肯定意味著他又在附近睡覺了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I didn't want to ask that sleepyhead for help, but he was the only person who was available.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我不太想求那個瞌睡蟲幫忙，但他卻是唯一有空的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you want me to get some mushroom spores, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以你是想讓我去弄些香菇芽孢，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
My friend, you're quick and sensible. Yes, please get some mushroom spores.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
朋友，你反應真快，也很懂事。是的，請幫我弄些香菇芽孢。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
On your way, perhaps you can beat down Trans Spore for training purposes. Catch about ten Trans Spores as well.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
在去的路上，為了鍛鍊一下，你可以順便打倒一些變形蘑菇。也請順便抓大約10只變形蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And why is that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼要這麼做？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You must get used to the job so that I can make you work again!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你得習慣這份工作，這樣我才能讓你繼續幹活！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
How can you force me to say such a thing?! You're so dense! Go, get going!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你怎麼能逼我說出這種話呢？你真是遲鈍！快去吧，趕緊出發！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may bring them to me when you're done, or you may give them to ^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000. Also, don't forget to kick his behinds!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
完成後你可以把它們帶給我，或者交給^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000。另外，別忘了踹他屁股！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Our cow...should eat lots of tasty stuff... Please take care of five Leaf Lunatics and five Grass Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們的奶牛...應該多吃點美味的東西... 請幫我處理5只群葉瘋兔和5只草地綠棉蟲。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You must hurry. We're almost done with the honey we have. Ten wild hornets!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你得快點。我們的蜂蜜快用完了。10只狂野蜂兵！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please help me make some pudding today. Catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請幫我今天做點布丁。抓10只甜心羅達蛙，並給我帶5個粘粘蛛絲！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please guard my strings. Catch ten Hunter Desert Wolves. That should be enough to keep them away from my strings.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請保護我的線。抓10只獵人沙漠狼。那樣應該足夠讓它們遠離我的線了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Can we make some fish cake today? I beg you. Please don't make me send my customers home empty handed. They came after a long time for fish cakes.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
今天能做些魚餅嗎？求求你了。請不要讓我讓顧客空手而歸。他們等了很久才來買魚餅。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please catch ten Trans Spores and bring me five mushroom spores. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請抓10只變形蘑菇，並給我帶5個香菇芽孢。快一點！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Now our cows can have lots of tasty grasses. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
現在我們的奶牛可以吃到很多美味的草了。謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Our cows liked you very much. That's surprising because they're usually very shy.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們的奶牛很喜歡你。這真讓人驚訝，因為它們通常非常害羞。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So can you do me another favor tomorrow? Oh, no need to answer right away. Get some good rest tonight and come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
那麼明天能再幫我個忙嗎？哦，不用馬上回答。今晚好好休息，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You took care of those wild hornets safely. Just amazing.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你安全地處理了那些狂野蜂兵。真了不起。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
So amazing that I want to ask for another favor tomorrow. Florin's been having a lot of difficulties lately.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
真了不起，我想明天再請你幫個忙。弗洛林最近遇到了很多困難。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Then see you again tomorrow!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
那麼明天見！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please help me make some pudding today. Catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs and bring me five sticky webfeet!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請幫我今天做點布丁。抓10只甜心羅達蛙，並給我帶5個粘粘蛛絲！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Five sticky webfeet. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
5個粘粘蛛絲。完美。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Oh, thank you! You saved me! I wish you can get a taste of the pudding made with this, but I'm so busy at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
哦，謝謝你！你救了我！我真希望你能嚐嚐用這個做的布丁，但我現在太忙了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
By the way, we're going to see each other again tomorrow, right?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
對了，我們明天還會再見的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Adventurer, I heard about your feats. Thanks to you, my strings are safe.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
冒險者，我聽說你的英勇事蹟了。多虧了你，我的琴絃才保住了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
I must repay you for saving my strings. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我必須報答你救下我的琴絃。非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
And can you help me again tomorrow? I want to entrust my strings with someone reliable.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
明天你能再幫幫我嗎？我想把琴絃託付給一個可靠的人。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Can we make some fish cake today? I beg you. Please don't make me send my customers home empty handed. They came after a long time for fish cakes.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
今天能做些魚餅嗎？求求你了。請不要讓我讓顧客空手而歸。他們等了很久才來買魚餅。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please catch ten Trans Spores and bring me five mushroom spores. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請抓10只變形蘑菇，並給我帶5個香菇芽孢。快一點！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Five mushroom spores. Perfect. It was wise to ask an adventurer for help.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
五個香菇芽孢。完美。向冒險者求助真是明智之舉。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
We almost lost all our customers who wanted fish cake. Thanks a lot!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們差點就失去了所有想吃魚糕的顧客。太感謝了！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
What, you're here already to help?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
什麼，你這麼快就來幫忙了？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
It's too early right now. Pushing won't solve anything.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
現在太早了。催促解決不了任何問題。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Have a nice rest and come back again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
好好休息，明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You here? Right when I needed some help.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你來了？正好我需要幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Will you help today as well?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
今天你也會幫忙嗎？

scripts.text: I'll try.
scripts.translation: 我會盡力。

scripts.text: I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 我很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm busy right now. I'll do it later.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在很忙。稍後再說。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please guard the grasses from Grass Fabre and Leaf Lunatic. They are food for our cows.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請保護草地，免受草地綠棉蟲和群葉瘋兔的侵害。那是我們奶牛的食物。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Grass Fabre and Leaf Lunatic, five each. That should scare the rest nearby and keep them at bay.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
草地綠棉蟲和群葉瘋兔，各五隻。這應該能嚇退附近其他的，讓它們不敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Once you cross the south bridge, you'll see crossroads. Take the road right underneath and go straight to the Raviol Plains where the shepherd is.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
過了南邊的橋，你會看到十字路口。走正下方的路，一直走到牧羊人所在的拉維奧平原。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me after catching all of them, or you can talk to the <NAVI>^4D4DFF[shepherd]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild01,353,370,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
抓完所有的之後你可以來找我，或者去找<NAVI>^4D4DFF[牧羊人]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild01,353,370,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Pay is same anywhere. You ready?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
無論在哪裡，報酬都是一樣的。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
A new day has just begun, and so will the wild hornets with their activities.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
新的一天開始了，狂野蜂兵的活動也將隨之開始。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Our honey is in danger!
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們的蜂蜜有危險了！

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please go to Raviol Forest and catch ten wild hornets.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請去拉維奧森林，抓十隻狂野蜂兵。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,102,372,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is collecting honey there.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
完成後你可以來找我，或者向正在那裡採蜜的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,102,372,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>報告。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You should go to Ravioli Forest. Please bring five sticky webfeet.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
你應該去羅比奧森林。請帶五隻粘粘蛛腳回來。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
While you're there, catch ten Sweet Roda Frogs. Their population has increased too much recently.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
既然去了，順便抓十隻甜心羅達蛙吧。最近它們的數量增加得太多了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may bring sticky webfeet to me if you get them, or you may take them to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Prok]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,177,241,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>. He agreed to bring them here anyway.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
如果你拿到了粘粘蛛腳，可以帶給我，也可以交給<NAVI>^4D4DFF[普羅克]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,177,241,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>。反正他也答應要把它們帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Listen carefully, because this is the most important request.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請仔細聽，因為這是最重要的請求。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please keep the Hunter Desert Wolves away from my strings. Catch ten wolves and they won't go after my strings anymore.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請讓獵人沙漠狼遠離我的線。抓住十隻狼，它們就不會再糾纏我的線了。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Fisher]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,326,170,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is drying fish in Raviol Forest.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
完成後你可以來找我，或者向正在羅比奧森林晾魚的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[漁夫]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,326,170,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>報告。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Good. An order for fish cake just came in.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
很好。剛好收到了一份魚糕的訂單。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
We didn't get orders for this menu that often, so It's strange that there's so many requests. Did the word spread finally that It's good?
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
我們很少接到這個選單的訂單，所以這麼多請求很奇怪。難道終於有人傳開了，說它很好吃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Anyhow, we're in a hurry down to the minute and seconds but that sleepyhead is probably sleeping again. So I hope that you, adventurer, can help us again.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
總之，我們分秒必爭，但那個瞌睡鬼大概又在睡覺了。所以希望冒險者你能再次幫幫我們。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
Please bring five mushroom spores and catch ten Trans Spores.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
請帶五個香菇芽孢，並抓住十隻變形蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Chef]
You may come to me when you're done, or you may report to <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Sleepy meow]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,331,251,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> who is dozing off in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[廚師]
完成後你可以來找我，或者向正在森林裡打瞌睡的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[瞌睡喵]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,331,251,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>報告。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today won't be boring? I wonder who'll visit me today. Who is it?
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
今天不會無聊吧？不知道今天誰會來找我呢。是誰呀？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is anybody here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有人在嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Ah! You're here. Come in. This is a magical place of miraculous elderly lady. It's a shrine.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
啊！你來了。請進。這裡是奇蹟老奶奶的魔法之地。這是一個神龕。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Elderly lady? She doesn't look like one. Like a very... young doram.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
老奶奶？她看起來不像啊。看起來非常...年輕的多蘭。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Not me!
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
不是我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who else?

[Shaman meow]
Grandma will be sad to hear that. This world is full of things that exist but cannot be seen. For instance, Let's talk about your case.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
老奶奶聽到這話會傷心的。這個世界上有很多存在但看不見的東西。比如，讓我們談談你的情況。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Before the discovery of the new world, we dorams thought that Lasagna was the end of the world. The new world was invisible and so were the countless people who lived there.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
在新世界被發現之前，我們多蘭認為羅札納就是世界的盡頭。新世界是看不見的，生活在那裡的無數人也是看不見的。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
But didn't the new world and human really exist?
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
但新世界和人類不是真的存在嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I get what you're saying.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白你的意思了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
So what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
那麼，是什麼讓你來到這裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is a sufferer and I'm here for that person.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有一位受害者，我是為了那個人而來的。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
What pain is that? If grandma and I can take care of it, we will. One shouldn't turn away from a sufferer.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
那是怎樣的痛苦？如果老奶奶和我能解決，我們一定會幫忙的。面對受苦的人，不應該袖手旁觀。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, he's in denial but I think he's been possessed by an evil spirit. He opened a sealed jar on an uninhabited island.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，他本人還在否認，但我認為他被邪惡的精靈附身了。他在一個無人島上打開了一個封印的罐子。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Oh my. Who would've thought that there would be another idiot like the ^0000cdboatswain of Con-Chliina^000000.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
天哪。誰能想到竟然還有像^0000cd康-奇利納的水手長^000000那樣的笨蛋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh, that boatswain is the person who had asked for my help.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，那位水手長就是請求我幫忙的人。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Indeed, who else would do such an idiotic thing? I can't help him, so please leave.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
確實，除了他還有誰會做這種蠢事？我幫不了他，請離開吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there really no way to help him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的沒有辦法幫他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Those evil spirits usually try to take over the host by absorbing his energy and leave when he dies. For some reason, they can't take over the host's body.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
那些邪惡的精靈通常會通過吸收宿主的能量來試圖奪取身體，並在宿主死後離開。出於某種原因，它們無法完全佔據宿主的身體。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
So they move on to another person nearby. That's why when the host dies, it is specially sealed in a jar by a shaman and discarded in a place where no one can find it.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
所以它們會轉移到附近的其他人身上。這就是為什麼當宿主死後，薩滿會將其特別封印在罐子裡，並丟棄在無人能找到的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
But if someone opens the jar, those evil spirits cling onto that idiot and repeat the same process. there's no way to detach them until the host dies. In other words, there's no solution that would make the boatswain happy.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
但如果有人打開了罐子，那些邪惡的精靈就會附著在那個笨蛋身上，重複同樣的過程。在宿主死亡之前，沒有辦法將它們分離。換句話說，沒有能讓水手長滿意的解決方案。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
When I told him that ��a noble person from a new place solves the problem,�� I meant that the problem will move onto ^0000cda new person^000000. Seems like he misunderstood me and sent you.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
當我告訴他“來自新地方的高貴之人會解決這個問題”時，我的意思是問題會轉移到^0000cd一個新的人^000000身上。看來他誤解了我的意思，派你來了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
T-then, you've also...

[Shaman meow]
I opened the jar. It was an unfortunate accident.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
是我打開了罐子。那是不幸的意外。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I-I don't mean that I dislike grandma. Yes, yes. I'll be careful.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
我...我不是說我不喜歡老奶奶。是的，是的。我會小心的。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Anyway, the boatswain has no choice. Live rest of his life, tormented, or become a shaman cat and live somewhat comfortably. Life of a shaman cat Isn't so bad.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
總之，水手長別無選擇。要麼帶著痛苦度過餘生，要麼成為薩滿貓，過上相對舒適的生活。薩滿貓的生活其實還不錯。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Those with much knowledge have a bit more options.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
知識淵博的人會有更多的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
If he chooses not to become a shaman meow, then he must live every day ^0000cddependent on a new talisman^000000. But if he chooses to become a shaman meow, then tell him to come see me.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
如果他選擇不成為薩滿喵，那麼他必須每天^0000cd依賴新的護符^000000。但如果他選擇成為薩滿喵，請讓他來見我。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
But becoming a shaman meow will be better in many ways. Evil spirits will wear him down more and more to take over his body.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
但成為薩滿喵在很多方面會更好。邪惡的精靈會不斷削弱他，試圖奪取他的身體。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I heard that the boatswain had visited previous shaman meow with Captain Gamberry in the past. But he stormed out in the middle of explanation and never came back.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
我聽說水手長以前曾拜訪過甘貝里船長身邊的前任薩滿喵。但他在解釋進行到一半時怒氣衝衝地離開了，之後再也沒回來過。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
He should be counting his days by now after suffering so much.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
經歷了這麼多苦難，他現在應該是在倒數著日子過吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not really. He seemed really energetic.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
倒也不是。他看起來精力很充沛。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I guess not everyone has what it takes to become the boatswain of Con-Chliina. How did he survive all this time?
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
看來並不是每個人都有資格成為康奇利納號的水手長。他是怎麼撐到現在的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... He seems to be living off on one superstition to another. Like dolls and salts.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...他似乎靠著一個又一個迷信活著。比如布偶和鹽。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Oh my, he really is an idiot. Had he come to me earlier, I would have told him about a less painful path.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
天哪，他真是個笨蛋。如果他早點來找我，我本可以告訴他一條不那麼痛苦的路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
At any rate, if he must depend on a new talisman every day, what's today's talisman? I'm sure the boatswain needs some time to think things over, so until then, he'll need talisman.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，如果他必須每天依賴新的護符，那今天的護符是什麼？我相信水手長需要時間考慮，在那之前，他需要護符。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman... Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
今天的護符...讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Oh, that? Really? Ooh, That's awful... Seriously, how would that...ugh.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
哦，那個？真的嗎？噢，那太糟糕了...說真的，那要怎麼...嘖。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basils and 5 basil locks^000000. Tie them firmly and carry them around. Then he'll be safe today.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
今天的護符是^0000cd20個羅勒和5個羅勒鎖^000000。把它們繫緊並隨身攜帶。這樣他今天就會安全了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Basil and basil lock?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
羅勒和羅勒鎖？

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
They both are obtained from those dirty ^0000cdbasilisks^000000. Basilisks received energy from Lord Imuk that lived over 2,000 years, so evil spirits can't stand even being near a piece of them.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
它們都來自那些骯髒的^0000cd蛇怪^000000。蛇怪接收了伊穆克大人2000多年前留下的能量，所以邪惡的精靈連靠近它們的一小部分都受不了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
But they really are way too filthy. I bet the boatswain will ask you for a favor since he won't want to catch one with his own hands.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
但它們實在太髒了。我打賭水手長會求你幫忙，因為他肯定不想親手去抓。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure. I'll tell him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然。我會告訴他。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Then see you again soon.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
那我們很快再見。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Make sure you deliver my message to the boatswain. And today's talisman is 20 basils and 5 basil locks.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
記得把我的話轉告給水手長。今天的護符是20個羅勒和5個羅勒鎖。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basil locks^000000. You'll get your hands very dirty today. I'm sorry. But grandma has spoken so That's the bottom line.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
今天的護符是^0000cd20個羅勒鎖^000000。今天你的手會很髒。我很抱歉。但老奶奶已經發話了，這就是底線。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman is ^0000cd5 basil locks and 1 holy water^000000. In the new world, the holy water drives the evil spirits away. It must've worked when the boatswain came in contact with the people of the new world.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
今天的護符是^0000cd5個羅勒鎖和1瓶聖水^000000。在新世界，聖水能驅趕邪惡的精靈。當水手長接觸新世界的人時，這肯定起作用了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Today's talisman is ^0000cd20 basils and 5 basil locks^000000. Same as the first. The most basic is the most useful.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
今天的護符是^0000cd20個羅勒和5個羅勒鎖^000000。和第一次一樣。最基礎的往往最有用。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
That thing clinging onto the boatswain is also a doram. It especially hates basil locks. That is the reason why basil locks are used.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
附著在水手長身上的那個東西也是多蘭。它特別討厭羅勒鎖。這就是使用羅勒鎖的原因。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I pray for your peace and safety. Tell the boatswain to come back anytime he changes his mind.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
我為您祈禱平安。請告訴水手長，如果他改變主意，隨時都可以回來。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
The boatswain must've sent you. I'll tell you about the talisman that'll help you get through today safely.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
一定是水手長派你來的吧。我會告訴你今天能保你平安的護符。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
Where... yes, yeah... today is that one? Got it.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
哪裡...是的，沒錯...今天是那個日子嗎？明白了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I'll tell you today's talisman. It is...
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
我來告訴你今天的護符。它是...

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
^0000cd20 basil locks^000000. You'll get your hands very dirty today. I'm sorry. But grandma has spoken so That's the bottom line.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
^0000cd20個羅勒鎖^000000。今天你的手會很髒。我很抱歉。但老奶奶已經發話了，這就是底線。

scripts.text: [Shaman meow]
scripts.translation: [薩滿喵]

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
^0000cd5 basil locks and 1 holy water^000000. In the new world, the holy water drives the evil spirits away. It must've worked when the boatswain came in contact with the people of the new world.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
^0000cd5個羅勒鎖和1瓶聖水^000000。在新世界，聖水能驅趕邪惡的精靈。當水手長接觸新世界的人時，這肯定起作用了。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
^0000cd20 basils and 5 basil locks^000000. Same as the first. The most basic is the most useful.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
^0000cd20個羅勒和5個羅勒鎖^000000。和第一次一樣。最基礎的往往最有用。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
That thing clinging onto the boatswain is also a doram. It especially hates basil locks. That is the reason why basil locks are used.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
附著在水手長身上的那個東西也是多蘭。它特別討厭羅勒鎖。這就是使用羅勒鎖的原因。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
I pray for your peace and safety. Tell the boatswain to come back anytime he changes his mind.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
我為您祈禱平安。請告訴水手長，如果他改變主意，隨時都可以回來。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
You want to know the future? The past? If you know where you're standing, then you can see the past, future, everything.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
你想看未來？還是過去？如果你知道自己在哪，就能看到過去、未來，以及一切。

scripts.text:
[Shaman meow]
If you need to curse someone, break a curse, or need a bit of luck, then come see me.
scripts.translation:
[薩滿喵]
如果你需要詛咒某人、解除詛咒，或者需要一點運氣，就來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Hello.
The weather is good today, isn't it?
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[義警嚮導]
你好。
今天天氣真好，不是嗎？
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Talk about the weather.
scripts.translation: 聊聊天氣

scripts.text: Ask about the Vigilante.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於義警的事

scripts.text: Ask about Lasagna.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於羅札納的事

scripts.text: End dialogue.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
In Lasagna, a fresh sea breeze always tickle your whiskers.
And thanks to this moist air, our cheese ripen deliciously.
scripts.translation:
[義警嚮導]
在羅札納，清新的海風總是輕撫著你的鬍鬚。
多虧了這溼潤的空氣，我們的乳酪才能熟得如此美味。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Oh! You haven't met our chief yet?
scripts.translation:
[義警嚮導]
哦！你還沒見過我們的首領嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Hmm...
I think it'd be best for you to see the chief first.
scripts.translation:
[義警嚮導]
嗯...
我想你最好先去找首領。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
He should be at the Adventurers' Club around now...
The Adventurers' Club is to the east from here, so it shouldn't be difficult to find.
scripts.translation:
[義警嚮導]
他應該就在附近的冒險者俱樂部...
冒險者俱樂部在從這裡往東的方向，應該不難找到。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
The Vigilante Corp not only maintain public order in the town, but also play the main role in running the town.
Maybe our chief should be called the mayor instead.
scripts.translation:
[義警嚮導]
義警公司不僅維護城鎮的公共秩序，還在城鎮管理中扮演主要角色。
也許我們的首領應該被稱為市長才對。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Lasagna is a port town located at the end of the Far-Star continent.
it's a small but a thriving town thanks to the efforts of Chief Peperoncino, Captain Gamberi, and Captain Tomatomas!
scripts.translation:
[義警嚮導]
羅札納是位於法爾斯塔大陸盡頭的港口城鎮。
多虧了首領 佩佩龍奇諾、船長 甘貝里和船長 番茄馬斯的努力，這裡雖然規模不大，卻十分繁榮！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Guide]
Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[義警嚮導]
再見。

scripts.text:
Yo!
Heya!
scripts.translation:
喲！
嗨！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
He is Chief Peperoncino, the boss of the Vigilante Corp!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
他是首領 佩佩龍奇諾，義警公司的老闆！

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！ -
- 您的物品欄已滿。 -
- 這意味著您無法再接收任何物品。 -
- 請騰出一些空間 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Yo!
If you need anything, just say the word!
I'll help you with what I can!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
喲！
如果你有什麼需要，儘管開口！
我會盡力幫你的！

scripts.text: Ask about the Vigilante.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於義警的事

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Let me tell you something about our Vigilante Corp!
You can say that we play a key role in this town!
All the young Doram want to join us too!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
讓我告訴你一些關於我們義警公司的事！
可以說我們在這個城鎮中扮演著關鍵角色！
所有年輕的多蘭都想加入我們！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
The Vigilante haven't been around for long, but Lasagna was a failing town before we showed up and it's thanks to us that the town is thriving now!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
義警公司成立的時間不長，但在我們出現之前，羅札納還是個衰敗的城鎮，多虧了我們，現在才變得繁榮起來！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
When I was a kid, it was so... so tough around here...
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
我小時候，這裡的日子...真是...太難熬了...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
There were none of these savory and comfy streets of cheese... Instead, we had mushy anchovy guts... everywhere you go...
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
那時候沒有這些美味又舒適的乳酪街道...到處都是軟爛的鯷魚內臟...走到哪裡都是...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
And don't talk about the smell...
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
更別提那股味道了...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
...
...
......

[Vigilante Olio]
Anyway! Enough of the depressing stuff!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
總之！別想那些令人沮喪的事了！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
The future looked bleak for Lasagna, but they discussed and decided that Chief Peperoncino would take charge of the Vigilante to protect the town, while the captains Gamberi and Tomatomas lead the merchant band.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
羅札納的未來曾一度黯淡無光，但經過討論，大家決定由首領 佩佩龍奇諾領導義警公司來保護城鎮，而船長 甘貝里和船長 番茄馬斯則領導商隊。

scripts.text: Ask about merchant band.
scripts.translation: 詢問關於商隊的事

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Well... I don't know much about the merchant band!
But I heard that it was started with the little seed money pooled by the three leaders, and now it has grown into a huge organization that makes most of this town's income.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
嗯...我對商隊的事瞭解不多！
但我聽說，它最初是由三位領袖湊集的一點啟動資金開始的，現在已經發展成一個龐大的組織，為這個城鎮帶來了大部分收入。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
In the beginning, they only had a single trading ship that leaked and was half sinking.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
起初，他們只有一艘漏水、快要沉沒的貿易船。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
But now, they have a massive fleet!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
但現在，他們擁有了一支龐大的艦隊！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
A few years ago, Captain Tomatomas embarked on a journey to discover a new trading route, but he went missing when his ship was caught up in a storm.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
幾年前，船長 番茄馬斯為了探索新的貿易路線而出發，但他的船在途中遭遇風暴，他因此失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
It was terrible back then!
Even our chief and Captain Gamberi had lost their calm.
They dropped everything and put all their efforts into finding Captain Tomatomas.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
那時候真是糟糕透了！
連我們的首領和船長 甘貝里都失去了冷靜。
他們放下手頭的一切，全力尋找船長 番茄馬斯。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
And...
Their efforts finally paid off, as Captain Tomatomas was recently found on an island called Malangdo off the coast of Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
然後...
他們的努力終於有了回報，船長 番茄馬斯最近被發現在米德加爾特海岸外的一座名為馬拉恩多的島上。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
On top of that, they also discovered a new sea route to the continent of Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
除此之外，他們還發現了一條通往米德加爾特大陸的新航線！

scripts.text: Ask about reaching the continent of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 詢問如何前往米德加爾特大陸

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
From here, the Con-Chliina is the only ship that can reach Midgard. So the only people who can board the ship are the Con-Chliina's sailors and members of the Vigilante Corp.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
從這裡出發，只有“康奇利納號”能抵達米德加爾特。所以只有康奇利納號的水手和義警成員才能登船。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Huh? aren't you from Midgard?
How did you get here in the first place?
can't you just go back the same way you came here?
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
咦？你不是米德加爾特人嗎？
那你一開始是怎麼來到這裡的？
難道不能原路返回嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Because of that, even people from other towns are flooding in to join the Vigilante and because of that, we had to turn a sentry post in the southern part of the Ravioli Plain into a waiting area.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
正因如此，連其他城鎮的人都蜂擁而來想要加入義警，所以我們不得不把拉維奧利平原南部的哨站改成了候船區。

scripts.text: Ask about joining the Vigilante.
scripts.translation: 詢問如何加入義警

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Huh?
you're interested too?
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
咦？
你也感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
No surprise there!
The Doram are nothing if not curious!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
這並不奇怪！
多蘭人可是出了名的好奇心旺盛！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
You need the chief's permission to join the Vigilante, so you'd better ask him.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
加入義警需要首領的許可，所以你最好去問問他。

scripts.text: Ask about boarding the Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation: 詢問如何登上康奇利納號

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Hmm...
I don't really know myself!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
嗯...
我自己也不太清楚！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
What can people from Midgard do...?
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
米德加爾特的人能做什麼呢...？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Go talk to the chief first.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
先去和首領談談吧。

scripts.translation:

What can people from Midgard do...?
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Go talk to the chief first.
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
先去和首領談談吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Yo!
If you need anything, just say the word!
I'll help you with what I can!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
喲！
如果你有什麼需要，儘管開口！
我會盡力幫你的！

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Nice to meet you.
I'm Chief Peperoncino of the Vigilante Corp.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
幸會。
我是義警組織的首領，佩佩龍奇諾。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
This is of little importance...
But did our vigilante member at the town's central plaza tell you something?
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
這沒什麼大不了的...
不過，城鎮廣場上的義警成員有沒有告訴你什麼？

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Is it your first time here?
With the discovery of the new sea route, we've had a sudden influx of foreigners visiting our town...
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
你是第一次來這裡嗎？
隨著新航線的發現，最近突然湧入了許多外國遊客...

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Hmm...
In any case, please enjoy your stay and don't cause any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
嗯...
總之，請在這裡玩得開心，不要惹事生非。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Olio!
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
奧利奧！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Olio]
Yes, Chief!!!
scripts.translation:
[義警 奧利奧]
是，首領！！！

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
If you need anything, talk to Olio here.
I've urgent matters to take care of and will take my leave.
Later, then.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
如果你需要什麼，就找這裡的奧利奧。
我有急事要處理，先走了。
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
If you need anything, talk to Olio here.
I've urgent matters to take care of and will take my leave.
Later, then.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
如果你需要什麼，就找這裡的奧利奧。
我有急事要處理，先走了。
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
什麼事？

scripts.text: Ask about joining the Vigilante.
scripts.translation: 詢問如何加入義警

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
With the way things are, you only need to pass a simple test if you want to join the Vigilante and take part in the 'Midgard Expedition'.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
以目前的情況來看，如果你想加入義警並參加“米德加爾特遠征”，只需要通過一個簡單的測試。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
But I'm a bit busy with urgent matters to give you the test now, so perhaps later...
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
不過我現在正忙著處理緊急事務，沒法現在給你測試，也許改天吧...

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Hmm...
No, wait!
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
嗯...
不，等等！

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Please follow me, this way.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
請跟我來，這邊。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
This way, please.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
請這邊走。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
There was Jindou's intervention, but I didn't think you'd complete the first test so easily...
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
雖然有金斗的介入，但我沒想到你能這麼輕鬆地通過第一個測試...

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
We'll move right on to the next test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
我們直接進行下一個測試。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
This time, Tali at the northwestern tip of Lasagna will give you a hand.
Go see her.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
這次，羅札納西北角的塔莉會協助你。
去找她吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
You're back.
It wouldn't have been... easy to deal with her, so well done.
And Tali brought these, saying there was a lot of cloths left over.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
你回來了。
對付她應該不容易吧，幹得好。
塔莉還帶了這些，說剩下的布料很多。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Right... That concludes the test.
I'd rather not be picky with the young people who are raring to go on an adventure, so this should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
好了...測試到此結束。
對於渴望冒險的年輕人，我不想太挑剔，所以這就足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Alright, congratulations on becoming a member of the Vigilante Corp.
The new adventures are yours to challenge.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
很好，恭喜你成為義警團的成員。
新的冒險正等待著你去挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Take this boarding pass to the port at the northern part of the town and they'll let you board the ship.
Hurry over to the port now.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
拿著這張搭船許可證去城鎮北部的港口，他們就會讓你上船。
現在快去港口吧。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Huu...
When I was younger, I also wanted to become someone great.
But there were too many things here that I had to protect...
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
呼...
年輕的時候，我也曾想成為偉大的人物。
但這裡有太多我必須守護的東西...

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
I suffered too much from seasickness to leave on an adventure.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
我暈船暈得太厲害了，沒法去冒險。

You need a 'solution' that suits the likes of him.
Even if that requires a bit of force.
scripts.translation:
[金斗]
你需要一種適合他的“解決方案”。
即使那需要一點武力。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Jindou.
This isn't your test.
We can't call it a test if you intervene, can we?
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
金斗。
這不是你的考試。
如果你插手的話，還能叫考試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jindou]
aren't you a mischievous man.
How can someone who's never faced a Basilisk before pass that test?
scripts.translation:
[金斗]
你還真是個愛搞惡作劇的傢伙。
一個從未面對過蛇怪的人，怎麼可能通過那個考試？

scripts.text:
[Jindou]
We aren't as laid-back as you people.
scripts.translation:
[金斗]
我們可不像你們那麼隨性。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Oh dear...
I guess there's no helping it.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
哎呀...
看來是沒辦法了。

scripts.text:
[Jindou]
Head out east from the town to the Ravioli Forest, and keeping going 'east' until you find huge thorny vines.
scripts.translation:
[金斗]
從城鎮出發往東走，進入羅比奧森林，
繼續往“東”走，直到你發現巨大的荊棘藤蔓。

scripts.text:
[Jindou]
Bring back 5 branches of those thorny vines.
scripts.translation:
[金斗]
帶回5根那些荊棘藤蔓的枝條。

scripts.text:
[Jindou]
We'll continue after you get back.
scripts.translation:
[金斗]
等你回來我們再繼續。

scripts.translation:

我絕不會告訴你們，我們要找的不是羅札納，而是住在洞穴裡的那個黃色東西！！！

scripts.text:

Stop!
That's more than enough.
Excellent work.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
停！
差不多了。
幹得漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Jindou, I'll leave the rest to you.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
金斗，剩下的交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Jindou]
Well, I don't think we can get anything more out of him, but I'll let you know if there's something new.
scripts.translation:
[金斗]
我想從他嘴裡也問不出更多了，但如果有什麼新情況，我會告訴你的。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Good.
you're as dependable as ever.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
很好。
你一如既往地可靠。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Alright, let's go outside and discuss your next test.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
好了，我們到外面去討論你的下一個考驗。

scripts.text:
[Jindou]
Oh, wait! You were a big help this time, so I'll give you this as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[金斗]
哦，等等！這次你幫了大忙，所以我要把這個作為謝禮送給你。

scripts.text:
