[{0}]
There's nothing to see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡沒什麼可看的。

scripts.text: Gamberry
scripts.translation: 甘貝里

scripts.text: Peperoncino
scripts.translation: 佩佩龍奇諾

scripts.text: Tomei Thomas
scripts.translation: 托梅·托馬斯

scripts.text: You close the book.
scripts.translation: 合上書

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
Captain of Con-Chliina.
Nickname is Berry.
Kaluna milk should be stirred.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
康-奇利納的船長。
綽號是貝里。
卡魯納牛奶應該攪拌著喝。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
His parents ran a butcher's shop in Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
他的父母在羅札納經營一家肉鋪。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
When he was young, he couldn't resist using violence to rehab hoodlum dorams. Thus, he is called the mad dog of Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
年輕時，他無法剋制自己用暴力手段整治流氓多蘭。因此，他被稱為羅札納的瘋狗。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
He met Peperoncino (current chief of Farfalle Vigilantes) at Pub-Oven by having disagreements over how to drink kaluna.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
他在“Pub-Oven”因卡魯納牛奶的喝法不同而與佩佩龍奇諾（現任法爾法勒義警首領）相識。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
He ended up working at the anchovy workshop with Peperoncino due to the debt he incurred at this time. Gamberry was recognized for his skills and became the workshop manager.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
由於當時欠下的債務，他最終與佩佩龍奇諾一起在鯷魚工坊工作。甘貝里因技藝精湛而被認可，成為了工坊管理員。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
They organized a merchant business with Thomas (current captain of Butterfly) who joined later.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
後來加入的托馬斯（現任蝴蝶號船長）與他們一起組建了一家商人公司。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
Having decided to expand their domain to the sea, Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and sailed out, but Captain Thomas went missing in a storm.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
決定將勢力擴充套件到海上後，甘貝里和托馬斯集結了一支艦隊並啟航，但托馬斯船長在風暴中失蹤了。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
Stello, Con-Chliina's first officer, discovered the sea route and finally found Butterfly that had safely reached Soft Island in the new world.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
康-奇利納的大副斯特洛發現了這條航線，並最終找到了安全抵達新世界軟島的蝴蝶號。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
Currently sails on the liner that connects Lasagna to the new world.
scripts.translation:
- 甘貝里 -
目前駕駛著連線羅札納和新世界的定期班船。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
Chief of Farfalle Vigilantes.
Nickname is Pepe.
Kaluna milk should be shaken.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龍奇諾 -
法爾法勒義警的首領。
綽號是佩佩。
卡魯納牛奶應該搖勻了喝。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
Besides the fact that he grew up poor in Fusilli, nothing else is known about his early days.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龍奇諾 -
除了他在富西利貧窮地長大之外，關於他的早年生活一無所知。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
He came to Lasagna with a grand plan to make a fortune by working on an anchovy fishing line, but gave up because of seasickness.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龍奇諾 -
他帶著在鯷魚捕撈線上發財的宏大計劃來到羅札納，但因為暈船而放棄了。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
Later, he began working at an anchovy workshop.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龍奇諾 -
後來，他開始在一間鯷魚工坊工作。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
He met Gamberry (current captain of Con-Chliina) at Pub-Oven by having disagreements over how to drink kaluna.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龍奇諾 -
他在酒館“Pub-Oven”與甘貝里（康奇利納號現任船長）相遇，兩人因卡魯納的喝法不同而產生了分歧。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
He ended up working at the anchovy workshop with Gamberry due to the debt he incurred at this time.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龍奇諾 -
由於當時欠下的債務，他最終與甘貝里一起在鯷魚工坊工作。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
They organized a merchant business with Thomas (current captain of Butterfly) who joined later.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龍奇諾 -
後來，托馬斯（蝴蝶號現任船長）加入，三人共同經營起了商隊業務。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
When Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and set out, Peperoncino organized and manages to this day Farfalle Vigilantes to maintain pubic order of Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龍奇諾 -
當甘貝里和托馬斯組建船隊出海時，佩佩龍奇諾組建並管理著法爾法勒義警，至今仍在維護羅札納的公共秩序。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Captain of Butterfly.
Nickname is Toto.
Kaluna milk should be shaken.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托馬斯 -
蝴蝶號的船長。
綽號是托托。
卡魯納牛奶應該搖勻了喝。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Born as Tomei Thomas but shortened to Thomas.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托馬斯 -
本名托梅·托馬斯，簡稱托馬斯。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Native of Lasagna, brought up affluently thanks to his wealthy parents.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托馬斯 -
羅札納人，父母富有，因此過著富裕的生活。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Grew up with Gamberry (current captain of Con-Chliina) as childhood friends.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托馬斯 -
與甘貝里（康奇利納號現任船長）是從小一起長大的朋友。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Worked with Gamberry and Peperoncino (current chief of Farfalle Vigilantes) at the anchovy workshop as a hobby.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托馬斯 -
曾與甘貝里和佩佩龍奇諾（法爾法勒義警現任首領）一起在鯷魚工坊工作，當作一種愛好。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
While the two spent all the money to pay off their debts, Thomas was able to save his wages. This became the initial fund for the merchant business.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托馬斯 -
那兩人花光了所有錢來償還債務，而托馬斯則攢下了工資。這筆錢成為了商隊業務的啟動資金。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Having decided to expand their domain to the sea, Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and sailed out, but Captain Thomas went missing in a storm.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托馬斯 -
為了將勢力擴充套件到海上，甘貝里和托馬斯組建船隊出海，但托馬斯船長在風暴中失蹤了。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Later, he safely arrived and settled in Soft Island of the new world. He's steadily expanding his domain.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托馬斯 -
後來，他安全抵達了新世界的軟島並定居下來。他正在穩步擴大自己的勢力範圍。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Pub-Oven]^000000
The place where Thomas, Peperoncino, and Gamberry met up to make agreements.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[Pub-Oven]^000000
托馬斯、佩佩龍奇諾和甘貝里在此聚會並達成協議的地方。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Pub-Oven]^000000
Today, it is an adventurers' club and a memorial, a must-see place for dorams going on an adventure.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[Pub-Oven]^000000
如今，這裡是一家冒險者俱樂部，也是一處紀念地，是前往冒險的多蘭必去之地。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Kaluna Milk]^000000
A beverage made by mixing kaluna and milk that three dorams drank when they met up. In their memory, it is now a festival beverage.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[卡魯納牛奶]^000000
一種將卡魯納和牛奶混合而成的飲料，是三位多蘭聚會時飲用的飲品。為了紀念他們，它現在成為了節日飲料。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Kaluna Milk]^000000
Mixing is usually done by stirring or shaking, but there is never-ending argument about these two methods.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[卡魯納牛奶]^000000
混合方式通常是攪拌或搖晃，但關於這兩種方法一直存在無盡的爭論。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Kaluna Milk]^000000
Depending on preference, one to three gooseberries can be added.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[卡魯納牛奶]^000000
根據個人喜好，可以加入一到三顆鵝莓。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Oven Resolution]^000000
Refers to the brotherhood formed in agreement by Thomas, Peperoncino, and Gamberry.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[爐火之約]^000000
指托馬斯、佩佩龍奇諾和甘貝里在協議中結成的兄弟情誼。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Butterfly]^000000
Known to have gone missing in a storm but later found to have safely arrived and established in the new world. After the news spread, Butterfly became widely known as the icon of adventure and heroes.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[蝴蝶號]^000000
曾傳聞在風暴中失蹤，但後來發現它安全抵達並在新世界建立了據點。訊息傳開後，蝴蝶號作為冒險和英雄的代名詞而廣為人知。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[L-Day]^000000
Abbreviation of Lasagna Day. It is the day when Butterfly, safely arrived in the new world, was found through the discovery of a new sea route after 32 search attempts.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[L日]^000000
羅札納日的縮寫。在嘗試了32次尋找新航線後，蝴蝶號被發現在新世界安全抵達的那一天。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[L-Day]^000000
Lasagna celebrates this day annually with magnificent fireworks and festivals.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[L日]^000000
羅札納每年都在這一天舉行盛大的煙花表演和慶典。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
看起來數量很多，體積也很大。要不要砍掉一些？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Doll, check.
Bell, check.
Dried Star Lilly, check.
Rope tied 33 times, check.
5 creases on the sail, check. Good!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
玩偶，確認。
鈴鐺，確認。
乾製星百合，確認。
繩子打了33個結，確認。
帆上有5道褶皺，確認。很好！

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What! Who broke this Pussy Willow branch!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
什麼！是誰弄斷了這根柳樹枝！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，這次即將開始新的冒險。很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
......

[Boatswain]
Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
哦，你就是那位即將前往新大陸冒險的新晉冒險者。我很欣賞這種冒險精神。我年輕時也曾四處遊歷。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
那是什麼時候的事？多久以前了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
不久之前。感覺就像昨天發生的一樣。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
昨天，你還在半夜的甲板上跑來跑去呢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Phew, such nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
哎呀，真是胡言亂語。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
嘿，我知道了。那裡太吵了。你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
副廚師長在起航前總是處於緊張狀態。別往心裡去。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
成熟的多蘭不會計較這些小事。你可以走了。我們要出發了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It is almost the time for us to sail off. You should go back.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
快要出發了。你應該回去了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Doll, check.
Bell, check.
Dried Star Lilly, check.
Rope tied 33 times, check.
5 creases on the sail, check. Good!

玩偶，確認。
鈴鐺，確認。
乾製星百合，確認。
繩子打了33個結，確認。
帆上有5道褶皺，確認。很好！

5 creases on the sail, check.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]

乾製星百合，確認。
繩子打了33個結，確認。
帆上有5道褶皺，確認。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What! Who broke this Pussy Willow branch!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
什麼！是誰弄斷了這根柳樹枝！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You seem to be in trouble. What is the matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看起來遇到了麻煩。怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
You don't seem to be experienced enough to resolve my problem. Come back after gaining more experience.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
你看起來經驗不足，無法解決我的問題。等你獲得更多經驗後再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
We need to take off anytime soon, and the preparation for sailing is not made properly.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我們隨時都要出發了，但航行準備工作還沒有做好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't know much about sailing, but none of those sounds relevant to the ship.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我對航海不太懂，但這些東西聽起來都和船沒關係啊。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It is not your business... Well, ^0000cda stranger from a new place is supposed to solve this problem^000000.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
這不是你的事... 唉，^0000cd來自新地方的陌生人，就該來解決這種問題^000000。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I am the sailor of sailors. The real seaman. I am the boatswain of this ship who is in charge of taking care of tough sailors and all the business on the deck. The story I am about to tell you... You shouldn't tell it to anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我是水手中的水手，真正的海員。我是這艘船的水手長，負責管理那些難搞的水手和甲板上的所有事務。我要告訴你的故事... 你可不能告訴別人。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Then you would learn how fearful a sailor can be.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
那樣你就會知道，水手其實有多膽小。

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什麼事？

scripts.text: I won't listen.
scripts.translation: 不聽

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Then go back to your spot. You shouldn't expect any favors from me from now on.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
那就回你的位置去。從現在起，別指望我會給你任何好處。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Good. I like the attitude that you don't give in for threats. So do I. Well, so did I.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
很好。我喜歡你不屈服於威脅的態度。我也是。嗯，以前也是。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why do you use a past tense?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你為什麼用過去式？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Do you believe in invisible things? Like those which don't really exist? Especially the special ones that appear in the night...
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
你相信看不見的東西嗎？比如那些並不真正存在的東西？尤其是那些在夜晚出現的特別的東西...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, the dead.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你是說死人。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
You are right. I had no fear. I enjoyed running into adventures and stuff. That's how I ended up in Lasagna and became the boatswain of Con-Chliina after meeting Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
你說得對。我以前並不害怕。我喜歡冒險之類的。就是這樣，我來到了羅札納，遇到了船長 甘貝里，成為了康克莉娜號的水手長。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I have been to everywhere. And one day, I found it.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我去過很多地方。然後有一天，我發現了它。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
There are numerous islands on the sea where no one lives. Sometimes, you find a pot buried in the middle of an island.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
海上有許多無人居住的小島。有時候，你會在島的中間發現一個埋著的罐子。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
When the ship was anchored in an unknown island to replenish water, I explored the island as I always did. And I found a ^0000cdsealed pot^000000 there.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
當船停泊在一個未知的小島補充淡水時，我像往常一樣探索了這座島。然後我在那裡發現了一個^0000cd封印的罐子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I shook it, but there was no sound. I was wondering what was in there making no sound when it had been sealed so carefully.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我搖了搖它，但沒有聲音。我很奇怪，既然封得這麼嚴實，裡面是什麼東西才會一點聲音都沒有。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Gamberi who came there tried to stop me, but I opened the seal. There was nothing in the ^0000cdpot^000000, and nothing happened.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
趕來的甘貝里試圖阻止我，但我還是打開了封印。^0000cd罐子^000000裡什麼都沒有，什麼也沒發生。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I threw away the pot and got on Con-Chliina. And it happened that night.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我扔掉了罐子，回到了康克莉娜號。然後，那天晚上，事情發生了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I guess we are getting into the good part. I really like it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，看來要進入精彩的部分了。我很喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Oh the night, I listened to this song. I could hear it anywhere. I could hear is from the creases in my palm, near my ear and the silver waves.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
那天晚上，我聽到了這首歌。我在任何地方都能聽到。我能從掌心的褶皺、耳邊以及銀色的波浪中聽到它。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It felt like I could grab the tune with my hand. When I was walking, following the sound, someone shook me hard. The next thing I noticed was that I was being held by the crews just before jumping off the ship.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我感覺我可以用手抓住那個旋律。當我跟著聲音走的時候，有人用力搖我。等我回過神來，發現自己正被船員們抓住，差點就要跳下船了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Enchanted by the song?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
被那首歌迷住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I thought so. I went to sleep with my ears closed. The strange thing is that it happened again the next day and the day after.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我也這麼覺得。我捂著耳朵睡著了。奇怪的是，第二天和第三天又發生了同樣的事。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Every night, I saw a dim silhouette or couldn't fall asleep because of the chattering noise in my ear. When I did fall asleep, I felt this weight on my body and woke up, covered in cold sweats.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
每天晚上，我都能看到模糊的身影，或者因為耳邊嘈雜的聲音而無法入睡。即使睡著了，我也感覺身上壓著什麼東西，醒來時渾身冷汗。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The pot turned out to be a pot in which an evil ghost has been sealed. Gamberi knew it and tried to stop me. However, it was too late. I had already broken the seal. I grew up in the land, and did not know about that at all.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
那個罐子原來封印著一個惡靈。甘貝里知道這一點，所以試圖阻止我。但已經太遲了，我已經打破了封印。我在內陸長大，對此一無所知。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I have been suffering from ^0000cdthe supernatural phenomenon^000000 ever since.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
從那以後，我就一直遭受^0000cd超自然現象^000000的折磨。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean whatever in there has cursed you, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是說裡面的東西詛咒了你，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Gamberi took me to the Shaman meow to get a counselling, but it didn't work. This evil ghost is too old, strong and possessive to be removed.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
甘貝里帶我去找薩滿喵諮詢，但沒用。這個惡靈太古老、太強大了，而且佔有慾極強，無法被驅除。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The only thing I could do was to weaken it as much as possible each day.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我能做的唯一事情，就是每天儘可能削弱它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is depending on all kinds of superstitions the way to weaken it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
靠各種迷信來削弱它？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
No other crews of Con-Chliina, except Captain Gamberi and I, know about this.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
除了船長甘貝里和我，康克莉娜號上沒有其他船員知道這件事。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The ^0000cdShaman meow^000000 has told me a riddle that a stranger from a new place will solve this problem. It is not a coincidence that we have met.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
^0000cd薩滿喵^000000告訴我一個謎題，說來自新地方的陌生人會解決這個問題。我們相遇並非巧合。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Please go and tell this story to the Shaman meow and bring me the remedy. I'll do anything for you if you get rid of it.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
請去把這個故事告訴薩滿喵，並帶給我解藥。如果你能除掉它，我會為你做任何事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anything? Is that a promise?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
任何事？這是承諾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Boatswain of Con-Chliina doesn't lie. If you don't trust me, you should trust Gamberi who has hired me as the Boatswain of Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
康克莉娜號的水手長從不撒謊。如果你不信任我，你應該信任僱用我擔任康克莉娜號水手長的甘貝里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll be back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很快回來。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Shaman meow lives in a secluded place near the entrance of the village.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
薩滿喵住在村莊入口附近一個偏僻的地方。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Shaman meow is living in a secluded place at the entrance of Lasagna. I hope that a stranger from a new place like you take care of my problem.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
薩滿喵住在羅札納入口附近一個偏僻的地方。我希望像您這樣來自新地方的陌生人能解決我的問題。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Dear adventurer, did you meet Shaman meow?
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
親愛的冒險者，您見到薩滿喵了嗎？

scripts.text: [You told the Boatswain the story you had heard from Shaman meow.]
scripts.translation: [你把從薩滿喵那裡聽來的故事告訴了水手長。]

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What? I should become a Shaman meow? What a nonsense! I am a sailor! I shall die on the sea as a sailor!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
什麼？我要變成薩滿喵？真是胡扯！我是水手！我要作為水手死在海上！

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I'd rather spend the rest of life fighting than living with the ghosts!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我寧願在戰鬥中度過餘生，也不願和幽靈們待在一起！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shaman meow is not as bad as you think. Why don't you go get a counseling when you have time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
薩滿喵並沒有您想的那麼壞。您有空的時候，不妨去尋求一下諮詢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I'll just pretend you didn't say that! I don't give a damn about a Shaman meow saying those malicious things!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我就當您沒說過這話！我才不在乎薩滿喵說的那些惡毒的話！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The evil ghost will absorb the life out of you. You won't last many days like this, dear Boatswain.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
邪惡的幽靈會吸乾您的生命。親愛的水手長，您這樣撐不了幾天了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What? Wait... That is...
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
什麼？等等...那是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can survive through a day with a ^0000cddaily amulet^000000. I guess you should be closer to the Shaman meow now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您可以靠^0000cd每日護符^000000撐過一天。我想您現在應該離薩滿喵更近了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
......

[{0}]
And today's amulet is ^0000cd20 Basils and 5 Basilrocks^000000. You can get them from the basilisks.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
今天的護符是^0000cd20個巴希爾和5個巴希爾巖^000000。您可以從巴希爾那裡獲得它們。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Ba... Basilisks... Out of the frying pan into the fire. I don't like to deal with those dirty things.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
巴...巴希爾...真是屋漏偏逢連夜雨。我不喜歡和那些髒東西打交道。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, That's it from me. I should get going...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，我說完了。我該走了...

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Yeah, the stranger taking care of this problem. It must have been our destiny.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
是啊，這個解決麻煩的陌生人。這一定是我們的命運。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, it meant that you would die and the evil ghost would find a new host.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，那意味著您會死，而邪惡的幽靈會找到新的宿主。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
No, no, never. You cannot get out of this like that. ^0000cdIt must have been our destiny.^000000 It is a fate! You should help me.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
不，不，絕不。您不能就這樣逃脫。^0000cd這一定是我們的命運。^000000這是命運！您應該幫助我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Well, just as I heard from Shaman meow. I was told that the Boatswain would make me do it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...好吧，正如我從薩滿喵那裡聽說的那樣。我被告知水手長會讓我這麼做。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
That Shaman meow sure seems to have the vision. I am a believer now. I believe the amulet is really effective. Please go get me one now. Please.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
那個薩滿喵似乎真有遠見。我現在是個信徒了。我相信護符真的有效。請現在去給我弄一個。拜託了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, I can't help it. Just for today.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我沒辦法。就今天這一次。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Today's amulet is 20 Basils and 5 Basilrocks! The sun will go down anytime soon!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
今天的護符是20個巴希爾和5個巴希爾巖！太陽馬上就要落山了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here are the Basil and Basilrock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是巴希爾和巴希爾巖。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Argh... Give it to me. No, no. Not like that. Just wrap it a little so that no one can see. Right. Like that. Give me all you have.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
啊...給我。不，不。不是那樣。稍微包一下，別讓任何人看到。對，就這樣。把你所有的都給我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is difficult.

[Boatswain]
This... This is...
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
這...這是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It feels like the black fog neat me is lifting! I don't hear the whispering sound anymore! My head feels so clear in a long time.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
感覺我身邊的黑霧正在消散！我再也聽不到那些低語聲了！我的頭腦很久沒有這麼清醒過了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It is unfair that I haven't known about this method so far!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
竟然到現在才知道這種方法，真是太不公平了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It only lasts a day. When it expires, it will be burnt up. I guess you should be close to Shaman meow from now on.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它只能維持一天。過期後就會燒燬。我想你以後應該多親近薩滿喵。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
No, never. I don't intend to be friends with Shaman meow or hunt the basilisks myself.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
不，絕不。我不打算和薩滿喵做朋友，也不打算自己去獵殺巴希爾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What are you going to do then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你打算怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Well, don't I have the ^0000cdnew helper^000000 in front of me?
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
嗯，我面前不是有^0000cd新助手^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I knew it!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我就知道！

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I will reward you handsomely. However, you haven't been able to solve the problem permanently so I don't have to keep the promise I have made.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我會好好報答你的。不過，既然你沒有徹底解決這個問題，我就不必遵守之前的承諾了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is unfair.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這太不公平了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I will reward you handsomely. Please do me another favor tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
我會好好報答你的。明天請再幫我一個忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We will see. I'll come back if I want to.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
再說吧。如果我想來，我會回來的。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Oh, you would come. I have a hunch.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
哦，你會來的。我有預感。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am pretty sure that it is the evil ghost talking to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很確定那是邪惡的幽靈在和你說話。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I'll let it slide since you have done me a favor. I'll see you again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
既然你幫了我，我就既往不咎了。明天見。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Did you bring the amulet for today? You seem to be empty-handed. Is there anything wrong?
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
你帶今天的護符了嗎？看起來你兩手空空。出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Please give it to me now. I feel the power of the amulet fading away now.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
請現在把它給我。我感覺護符的力量正在消退。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
This is the amulet for today! Give me all the Basilrocks you have.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
這是今天的護符！把你所有的巴希爾巖都給我。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It feels like watching the blue horizon on a clear and windless day. It is refreshing.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
就像在晴朗無風的日子看著藍色的地平線一樣。真令人神清氣爽。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It feels like watching the clouds go by lying on my back on a green hill.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
就像躺在綠色的山坡上，仰面看著雲朵飄過一樣。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It feels like seeing the sunshine through the black fog.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
就像在漆黑的迷霧中看見陽光一樣。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Thank you for getting them for me. Please come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
謝謝你幫我拿到它們。明天請再來。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
You said you would come if you wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
你說過，想來的時候就會來。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The amulet is still effective. Go to see Shamanyang after ^0000cd4:00 am^000000 and bring me tomorrow's amulet.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
護符仍然有效。在^0000cd凌晨4:00^000000之後去找薩瑪尼揚，然後帶明天的護符給我。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
You said you would come if you wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
你說過，想來的時候就會來。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
However, you shouldn't have come to me. You should have gone to ^0000cdShamanyang^000000 and asked about today's amulet.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
不過，你不該來找我。你應該去找^0000cd薩瑪尼揚^000000，詢問今天的護符。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
I am counting on you then.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
那就拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
看起來又多又大。要不要砍掉一些？

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
We can go anywhere if we have the wind and the sail.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
只要有風和帆，我們就能去任何地方。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，這次即將開始新的冒險。很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
......

[Boatswain]
Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
哦，你就是那位即將前往新大陸冒險的新晉冒險者。我很欣賞這種冒險精神。我年輕時也曾四處遊歷。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
那是什麼時候的事？多久以前了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
不久之前。感覺就像昨天發生的一樣。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
昨天，你還在半夜的甲板上跑來跑去呢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Phew, such nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
哎呀，真是胡言亂語。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
嘿，我知道了。那裡太吵了。你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
副廚師長在起航前總是處於緊張狀態。別往心裡去。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
成熟的多蘭不會計較這些小事。你可以走了。我們要出發了。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
The Sous Chef believes that it brings bad luck to have a stranger while cooking. You should go now.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
副廚師長認為，做飯時有陌生人在場會帶來厄運。你現在應該走了。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
We can go anywhere if we have the wind and the sail.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
只要有風和帆，我們就能去任何地方。

scripts.text:
[Cow]
Moo -
scripts.translation:
[奶牛]
哞——

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Take your filthy hand off from her! [Woncow] is sensitive, so no one besides me can touch her!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
把你那髒手拿開！[元]很敏感，除了我，誰都不能碰她！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A cow's name is [Woncow]...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
奶牛的名字叫[元]...

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
So? What! I won her on a bet. Every time I call her name, it reminds me of that moment of victory. It's beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
那又怎樣！我打賭贏來的。每次叫她的名字，都會讓我想起那個勝利的時刻。這很美好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anyway, why is there a cow on this ship?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
總之，為什麼這艘船上有頭奶牛？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Why? Because we want to drink fresh milk every day!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
為什麼？因為我們想每天喝新鮮牛奶！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You brought a cow on board for fresh milk?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你為了喝新鮮牛奶，把奶牛帶上船了？

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
The boatswain can't leave her side for a second because she's his goddess of fortune. Lucky for us, we can have kaluna milk every day.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
水手長一刻都離不開她，因為她是他的幸運女神。幸運的是，我們每天都能喝到卡魯納牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Hey! Keep talking and you'll jinx it!
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
嘿！再這麼說下去，你會帶來厄運的！

scripts.text:
[Head Chef]
*Snore*
scripts.translation:
[主廚]
*呼嚕*

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
看起來很多也很大。要不要切掉一些？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It is going to be the time to eat soon. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
快該吃飯了。我得加快速度。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，這次即將開始新的冒險。很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
......

[Boatswain]
Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
哦，你就是那位即將前往新大陸冒險的新晉冒險者。我很欣賞這種冒險精神。我年輕時也曾四處遊歷。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
那是什麼時候的事？多久以前了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
不久之前。感覺就像昨天發生的一樣。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
昨天，你還在半夜的甲板上跑來跑去呢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Phew, such nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
哎呀，真是胡言亂語。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
嘿，我知道了。那裡太吵了。你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
副廚師長在起航前總是處於緊張狀態。別往心裡去。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
A mature Doram doesn't hold on to such things. You may go. We are about to set off.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
成熟的多蘭不會計較這些小事。你可以走了。我們要出發了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Ask the Purser when the sailing sign will be issued. Depending on the time, we need to either change the ingredients or replenish them.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
去問問事務長什麼時候發出起航訊號。根據時間不同，我們需要更換或補充食材。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dear Sous Chef.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
親愛的副廚師長。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Keep it short. I am busy.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
長話短說。我很忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I mean, ^0000cdhere comes the newbie!^000000

[Sous Chef]
What are you doing? Is it a new way to get yourself killed? I am not afraid of challenges. Draw your weapon.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你在幹什麼？這是新的自殺方式嗎？我不怕挑戰。拔出你的武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't mean.... I don't mean... That...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是那個意思... 我不是... 那個...

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You tiny rat! Now tell me. I don't think a rookie like you would come up with this on your own. Who sent you here?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你這隻小老鼠！現在告訴我。我不認為像你這樣的新人會自己想到這個。是誰派你來的？

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Sous Chef! I think this guy's telling the truth. It is ordered by you, right?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
副廚師長！我覺得這傢伙說的是實話。是你下的命令，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
^0000cdKahlugnag^000000? That Eggring! He made this newbie do this and pull off a prank! Hey, I am sorry. Please accept my apology.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
^0000cd卡魯納^000000？那個蛋黃波利！是他讓這新人這麼做，搞惡作劇的！嘿，對不起。請接受我的道歉。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I'll make sure to tell him to say sorry to you. He is such a trouble. He will always be nothing but a sailor boy.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我會讓他向你道歉的。他真讓人頭疼。他永遠只是個水手男孩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, never mind.

[Sous Chef]
Do you like ^0000cdfood^000000 ?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你喜歡^0000cd食物^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes! I do!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喜歡！我非常喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I mean making it, not eating it.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我是說製作，不是吃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh, I have never tried it, but I believe I would like it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，我從來沒試過，但我相信我會喜歡的。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
When you come back later, ^0000cdI'll teach you how to cook^000000. It is my way of saying sorry. Well, you may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
等你回來時，^0000cd我會教你怎麼做菜^000000。這是我表達歉意的方式。好了，你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Hey newbie! Ask the Purser when we will be sailing off on your way. I think something has gone wrong since there is no sign so far.
scripts.translation:
[水手長]
嘿，新人！離開時問問事務長我們什麼時候起航。我覺得出問題了，因為目前還沒有訊號。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
OK, I will!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我會的！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It is going to be the time to eat soon. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
快該吃飯了。我得加快速度。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Are you here to learn how to cook?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你是來學做飯的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you want to learn how to cook, come to see me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
如果你想學做飯，隨時都可以來找我。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You don't seem to be a novice anymore. I cannot teach you any further since I am too busy. If you want to explore the world of cooking more, you should find someone else.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你看起來已經不是初心者了。因為我太忙了，沒法再教你更多了。如果你想更深入地探索烹飪的世界，應該去找別人。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I have heard that there is someone who teaches how to cook in the palace of the new continent. It would be a good idea to check out.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我聽說在新大陸的宮殿裡，有人教怎麼做菜。去那裡看看是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Good food can ^0000cdraise a certain status^000000 and ^0000cdrecover HP^000000. There is no reason not to cook and eat.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
美味的食物可以^0000cd提升特定狀態^000000，並且^0000cd恢復HP^000000。沒有理由不烹飪並享用它們。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
There are two main functions of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
烹飪有兩個主要功能。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Firstly, it ^0000cdenhances status^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
首先，它^0000cd增強狀態^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
There are six types of cooking. Each enhances ^0000cdStr, Agi, Vit, Int, Dex or Luk^000000. The amount of status enhancement depends on the level of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
有六種型別的烹飪。每種分別增強^0000cd力量、敏捷、體質、智力、靈巧或幸運^000000。狀態提升的幅度取決於烹飪等級。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Secondly, it ^0000cdrecovers HP and SP^000000. The amount of recovery also depends on the level of cooking, and some food only recovers HP.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
其次，它^0000cd恢復HP和SP^000000。恢復量也取決於烹飪等級，有些食物只恢復HP。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
In order to cook such dishes, you need to make some preparation.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
為了烹飪這樣的菜餚，你需要做一些準備。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
There are two steps for the preparation.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
準備有兩個步驟。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
First! You need a ^0000cdCookbook^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
第一！你需要一本^0000cd食譜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You need a Cookbook to learn how to prepare the ingredients and cook. You can get this Cookbook from a ^0000cdquest^000000 or a ^0000cdmonster^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你需要食譜來學習如何準備食材和烹飪。你可以從^0000cd任務^000000或^0000cd魔物^000000那裡獲得這本食譜。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Once you get a Cookbook, you need to collect the ^0000cdingredients^000000. It doesn't help to lick the pages if the Cookbook without preparing the ingredients. Even the eggrings know better than that.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
一旦你獲得了食譜，就需要收集^0000cd食材^000000。如果不準備食材，舔食譜的頁面是沒用的。連蛋黃波利都比這更懂道理。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get the ingredients from the ^0000cdmonsters^000000 or the ^0000cdIngredient Merchants^000000. Although it takes quite a preparation to cook, the effectiveness is worth it.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以從^0000cd魔物^000000或^0000cd食材商人^000000那裡獲得食材。雖然烹飪需要相當多的準備，但效果是值得的。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Oh, by the way, you need to know that ^0000cdcooking may fail^000000. The chance of failure depends on the cooking utensils you have and the level of your cooking.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
哦，順便說一下，你需要知道^0000cd烹飪可能會失敗^000000。失敗機率取決於你擁有的烹飪工具和你的烹飪等級。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Well then, Let's start cooking. Talk to me again when you are ready!
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
好了，讓我們開始烹飪吧。準備好後再來找我！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Let's see. Did you bring all the ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
讓我看看。你帶齊所有食材了嗎？

scripts.text: [Sous Chef]
scripts.translation: [副廚師長]

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
[Sous Chef]
Are you ready? Action speaks louder than words! Let's start cooking!
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你準備好了嗎？行動勝於言語！讓我們開始烹飪吧！

scripts.text: Go hunting after eating this. You won't believe the newfound power in you.
scripts.translation: 吃完這個再去打獵吧。你會相信自己體內湧動的全新力量。

scripts.text: If you eat this, you can move much faster than others. Even faster than a hummingbird flapping its wings.
scripts.translation: 吃了這個，你的移動速度會比別人快得多。甚至比蜂鳥扇動翅膀的速度還要快。

scripts.text: don't you feel the mysterious power pumping through your vessels already? You cannot resist it!
scripts.translation: 難道你還沒感覺到那股神秘的力量在血管中奔湧嗎？你無法抗拒它的！

scripts.text: You will become more skillful when you have a bite of this.
scripts.translation: 吃一點這個，你的技巧會變得更高超。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Are you ready? Action speaks louder than words! Let's start cooking!
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你準備好了嗎？行動勝於言語！讓我們開始烹飪吧！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Actually, you need the recipe and the cooking utensils, but it could be too complicated for a novice. I'll make one for you this time. We shouldn't waste the ingredients, you know.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
其實你需要食譜和烹飪工具，但這對於初心者來說可能太複雜了。這次我幫你做一份吧。我們可不能浪費食材，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Since it is a trial version for novice, it has the same effect as level 1 food, but ^0000cdit doesn't last as long.^000000
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
既然是給初學者的試用版，它的效果和1級食物一樣，但^0000cd持續時間不會那麼長。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What kind of food do you like to eat? Since Int or Luk dishes won't do much good for you, you can make four kinds of dishes for now.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你喜歡吃什麼？既然智力或幸運類料理對你沒什麼幫助，目前你可以製作四種料理。

scripts.text: Fragrant Seasoned Herbs
scripts.translation: 芳香調味香草

scripts.text: Crunchy Salad
scripts.translation: 脆爽沙拉

scripts.text: Mixed Stew
scripts.translation: 混合燉菜

scripts.text: Baked Gold Apple
scripts.translation: 烤金蘋果

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
^0000cdFragrant Seasoned Herbs^000000. It enhances ^0000cdStr^000000. The people who use a lot of physical strength eat this.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
^0000cd芳香調味香草^000000。它能提升^0000cd力量^000000。經常使用體力的人都會吃這個。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Clover, 1 Green Herb and 1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
食材是^0000cd1個三葉草、1個綠色藥草和1個紅色藥草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Clovers and Red Herbs from Leaf Lunatic or Grass Fabre in the field outside.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以在外面的野外從群葉瘋兔或草地綠棉蟲身上獲得三葉草和紅色藥草。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Green Herbs from Grass Fabre.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以從草地綠棉蟲身上獲得綠色藥草。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
如果你帶齊所有食材，我們就能烹飪了。快點吧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The^0000cd Crunchy Salad^000000! I really like this dish. You have a good taste.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
^0000cd脆爽沙拉^000000！我真的很喜歡這道菜。你的品味真好。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The Crunchy Salad enhances ^0000cdAgi^000000. The people who wants to attack faster or who doesn't want to get hit tend to eat it.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
脆爽沙拉能提升^0000cd敏捷^000000。想要攻擊更快或者不想被擊中的人通常會吃它。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple and 2 Carrots^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
食材是^0000cd1個蘋果和2個胡蘿蔔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Apples from the Eggring jumping in the outer field of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以在依斯魯得島外圍的野外，從跳動的蛋黃波利身上獲得蘋果。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get the Carrots from Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以從群葉瘋兔身上獲得胡蘿蔔。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook!
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
如果你帶齊所有食材，我們就能烹飪了！

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ^0000cd Mixed Stew.^000000 It enhances ^0000cdVit^000000. It really fills you up so you don't feel mush pain even when you are hit by the monster.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
^0000cd什錦燉菜^000000。它能提升^0000cdVIT^000000。吃了之後會非常飽腹，即使被魔物攻擊也不會感到太多疼痛。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Jellopy , 1 Fluff, and 1 Feather^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
食材是^0000cd1個傑勒比結晶、1個絨毛和1根羽毛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Jellopies from the Eggring jumping in the outer field.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以在外圍的野外，從跳動的蛋黃波利身上獲得傑勒比結晶。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Fluffs from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以從草地綠棉蟲或群葉瘋兔身上獲得絨毛。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Feathers from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以從草地綠棉蟲或群葉瘋兔身上獲得羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
如果你帶齊所有食材，我們就能烹飪了。快點吧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ^0000cdBaked Gold Apple^000000. It is hard to resist the golden hue on its surface.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
^0000cd烤金蘋果^000000。它表面那層金色的光澤讓人難以抗拒。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It enhances ^0000cdDex^000000. The ones who'd like to raise the Hit tend to eat this.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
它能提升^0000cdDEX^000000。想要提高命中率的人通常會吃這個。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple and 1 Clover^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
食材是^0000cd1個蘋果和1個三葉草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Apples from the Eggring in the outer field.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以在外圍的野外，從蛋黃波利身上獲得蘋果。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You can get Clovers from Grass Fabre or Leaf Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你可以從草地綠棉蟲或群葉瘋兔身上獲得三葉草。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring all the ingredients, we can cook. Hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
如果你帶齊所有食材，我們就能烹飪了。快點吧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I need someone to ask a favor. You don't seem experienced enough.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我需要找人幫忙。你看起來經驗還不夠豐富。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I told you not to enter the kitchen like that... Oh... Are you from the new continent?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我說過不要那樣進廚房的... 噢... 你是來自新大陸的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I see you around often these days. You look so strange. The face without any whiskers and the butt with no tail.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
最近經常看到你。你看起來很奇怪。臉上沒有鬍鬚，屁股上也沒有尾巴。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Please excuse me. I am the Sous Chef in charge of this kitchen.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
請多關照。我是負責這間廚房的副廚師長。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am {1}.

[Sous Chef]
Your name is strange too.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你的名字也很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I told you not to enter the kitchen like that... Oh... You seem familiar...
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我說過不要那樣進廚房的... 噢... 你看起來很面熟...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am an adventurer {1} who has set off on an adventure on Con-Killina.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。我是{1}，一名前往康基利納冒險的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Is that so? Let me introduce myself. I am the Sous Chef in charge of this kitchen.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
是嗎？讓我自我介紹一下。我是負責這間廚房的副廚師長。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about the Head Chef? Why is the Sous Chef in charge of the kitchen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那主廚呢？為什麼是副廚師長在管理廚房？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Look over there. The man sleeping on the floor who seems so far from being a gentleman. ^0000cdHe is our Head Chef^000000. The captain has always said how we have to do our best at what we do. But no use.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
看那邊。那個睡在地板上、一點也不像紳士的男人。^0000cd他就是我們的主廚^000000。船長總是說我們要盡力做好自己的工作。但沒用。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Do you know what is the most important thing in cooking? It is the endless passion and pursuit of the best taste. Nevertheless, our Head Chef has no interest in such things.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你知道烹飪最重要的是什麼嗎？是對最佳味道的無限熱情和追求。然而，我們的主廚對此毫無興趣。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
However, he is very good at making enough servings to feed a number of people in a short time. That is why he has become the Head Chef. But when people started complaining about the taste, I was called in.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
不過，他很擅長在短時間內做出足夠多人的份數。這就是他成為主廚的原因。但當人們開始抱怨味道時，我就被叫來了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Ever since, the Head Chef entrusted me with everything.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
從那以後，主廚就把一切都託付給我了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I believe the people of the new continent eat different food from us. What do the people find delicious in the new continent?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我相信新大陸的人吃的食物和我們不同。新大陸的人覺得什麼好吃？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I'd like to go out there and taste each dish. However, if I do, the crews of this ship will starve to death.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我想出去嚐嚐每一道菜。但是，如果我去了，這艘船的船員們就會餓死。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hum, there are many kinds of food. We also hunt the ingredients and cook. There are many things for sure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，有很多種食物。我們也打獵獲取食材並烹飪。肯定有很多東西...

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I happen to have a ^0000cdCookbook of the new continent^000000. Do you have any of the ingredients for the food now?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我正好有一本^0000cd新大陸食譜^000000。你現在有這些食物的食材嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not really...

[Sous Chef]
Well, then let me ask you a favor. Please bring me some of the ingredients in this ^0000cdCookbook^000000. This thing called ^0000cdMastela Fruit Wine^000000... I am curious about this, but it requires some ingredients which are not found here.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
那麼，請幫我一個忙。請帶一些這本^0000cd食譜^000000裡的食材給我。這個叫^0000cd瑪絲黛拉果酒^000000的東西...我很好奇，但它需要一些這裡找不到的食材。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
And please get me some ^0000cdCat Hardtacks made by the Head Chef of Navi^000000 as well. I have heard that it doesn't taste good, but it is nutritious and easy to store.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
另外，請幫我弄一些^0000cd由納維主廚製作的貓乾糧^000000。我聽說它味道不好，但營養豐富且易於儲存。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Please bring me ^0000cd4 Mastela Fruit and 1 Cat Hardtack^000000.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
請帶給我^0000cd4個瑪絲黛拉果實和1個貓乾糧^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If you bring them to me, I'll reward you handsomely.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
如果你把它們帶給我，我會重重地獎勵你。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Well then. I am counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
那麼。我就指望你了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What happened to the favor I asked you. 4 Mastela Fruit and 1 Cat Hardtacks.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我拜託你的事怎麼樣了？4個瑪絲黛拉果實和1個貓乾糧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You have brought them so fast. I can challenge making new cuisines with these. My heart is pounding so hard.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你來得真快。有了這些，我可以挑戰製作新菜式了。我的心跳得好快。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
May I ask more favors next time? You know, the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
下次我可以再拜託你嗎？你知道的，食材。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me drop by when I get time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有空的時候我會順路過來。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你離開不久。已經拿到了嗎？還是忘了我讓你帶什麼了？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
^0000cd20 Buns^000000. In order to keep them fresh, you should hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
^0000cd20個饅頭^000000。為了保持新鮮，請快點。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Oh, this is the Bun... It sure is hot and huge. This is totally different from that of our side.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
哦，這是饅頭...真熱，個頭也很大。這和我們這邊的完全不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Thank you for bringing them to me. Thanks to you, the food of Lasagna can take another step forward.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
謝謝你把它們帶給我。多虧了你，羅札納的美食能再進一步。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你離開不久。已經拿到了嗎？還是忘了我讓你帶什麼了？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Bring ^0000cd5 Cat Hardtacks and 5 Malangdo Canned Food^000000. Please hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
帶^0000cd5個貓乾糧和5個瑪朗多罐頭^000000。請快點。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Cat Hardtack and Malangdo Canned Food... Well, they will last long enough.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
貓乾糧和瑪朗多罐頭...嗯，它們能儲存很久。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Thank you form getting them for me. Now Con-Chliina can come up with our own ways to store food for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
謝謝你幫我弄到它們。現在Con-Chliina可以研究出我們自己的長期儲存食物的方法了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
It hasn't been long since you left. Have you got them already? Or have you forgotten what I have asked you for?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你離開不久。已經拿到了嗎？還是忘了我讓你帶什麼了？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
You should bring ^0000cd20 ice cubes^000000. It is to keep the stored food fresh. Please hurry up.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
你應該帶^0000cd20塊冰塊^000000。這是為了保持儲存食物的新鮮。請快點。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
The ice cubes. I am just so excited to see them. The ice cubes that don't melt! It sure is the new continent.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
冰塊。看到它們我真是太興奮了。不會融化的冰塊！這真是新大陸啊。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Thank you for bringing them to me. Thanks to you, the crews of Con-Chliina can have some fresh food.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
謝謝你把它們帶給我。多虧了你，Con-Chliina的船員們能吃到新鮮的食物了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What brought you here? Is it about the favor yesterday?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
什麼事把你帶到這裡？是關於昨天拜託你的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Since I am on duty, I cannot proceed with any personal study of cooking. Come back after the break of day.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
既然我在值班，就不能進行個人的烹飪研究了。等休息的時候再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Just in time. I just have a moment to spare and I'd like to keep working on my study of the cuisine in the new continent. Would you get some ingredients for me?
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
正好。我剛好有點空，想繼續研究新大陸的料理。你能幫我弄些食材嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What I need to day is the ^0000cdBun^000000. We have something similar in Lasagna, but the recipe is totally different.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我今天需要的是^0000cd饅頭^000000。羅札納有類似的東西，但配方完全不同。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
What I need to day are the ^0000cdCat Hardtack and Malangdo Canned Food^000000. I am curious how the crews of Navi survived through such a long voyage.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我今天需要的是^0000cd貓乾糧和瑪朗多罐頭^000000。我很好奇Navi的船員們是如何在漫長的航行中生存下來的。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I need ^0000cdIce Cubes^000000 today. I have heard that the Ice Cubes from this one cave doesn't melt even in the middle of summer.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我今天需要^0000cd冰塊^000000。我聽說這個洞穴裡的冰塊即使在盛夏也不會融化。

scripts.text: [Sous Chef]
scripts.translation: [副廚師長]

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I'd like to know how it is made. Please bring me some. ^0000cd20 Buns^000000 would do.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我想知道它是怎麼做的。請帶一些給我。^0000cd20個饅頭^000000就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
I'd like to know how they are made. Please bring me some. ^0000cd5 Cat Hardtacks and 5 Malangdo Canned Food^000000 would do.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
我想知道它們是怎麼做的。請帶一些給我。^0000cd5個貓乾糧和5個瑪朗多罐頭^000000就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
If we had those, we could keep food fresh and drink cold Kahlugna Milk anytime. ^0000cd20 Ice Cubes^000000 would do, Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
如果有了它們，我們就能隨時保持食物新鮮，並讓卡魯納牛奶保持冰鎮。^0000cd20個冰塊^000000就夠了，謝謝你。

scripts.text: What do you expect me to do without the ingredients?
scripts.translation: 沒有食材，你指望我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Bring me {0} now!
scripts.translation:
[副廚師長]
現在就把{0}帶給我！

scripts.text: Oh, you have brought them all! Let me cook them for you right away.
scripts.translation: 哦，你都帶來了！讓我馬上為你烹飪。

scripts.text: [Sous Chef]
scripts.translation: [副廚師長]

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。我是

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The adventurer from the new continent. What brought you here? Do you need help?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
來自新大陸的冒險者。是什麼把你帶到這裡的？需要幫助嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that we couldn't set off because of the fog. I am here to check the condition of the dragon inside the cave.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說因為大霧，我們無法出發。我是來檢視洞穴裡那條龍的情況的。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Are you going to do that yourself?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你要自己去嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很著急。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The fog is covering the sky. The ^0000cdpatrol^000000 hasn't returned yet, so it may take some time.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
大霧籠罩著天空。^0000cd巡邏隊^000000還沒有回來，可能需要一些時間。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please let me know where the dragon lives.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請告訴我龍住在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Come with me then. The <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
那就跟我來吧。<NAVI>^4D4DFF[龍巢]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>就在村莊外田野盡頭的洞穴裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。我是

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
What are you doing here? Did you miss the ship?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你在這裡做什麼？是錯過了船嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard that we couldn't set off because of the fog. I am here to check the condition of the dragon inside the cave.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說因為大霧，我們無法出發。我是來檢視洞穴裡那條龍的情況的。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The fog? Huh! The fog! When did this happen? And the patrol hasn't returned yet.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
大霧？哈！大霧！這是什麼時候開始的？而且巡邏隊還沒有回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then the Dragon is...

[Vigilante]
The patrol who went to check it ^0000cdhasn't returned yet^000000. Something must have happened. You said you would go there to check the condition of the dragon, right? Come with me.Stone
scripts.translation:
[義警]
去檢視情況的巡邏隊^0000cd還沒有回來^000000。一定發生了什麼。你說你要去檢視龍的情況，對吧？跟我來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Where?

[Vigilante]
You know, the <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>. It is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village. You should go first. I'll follow you after making some preparations.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你知道的，<NAVI>^4D4DFF[龍巢]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>。它在村莊外田野盡頭的洞穴裡。你應該先走，我做好準備後就跟上來。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave on the right side. Come with me then.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[龍巢]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>在右邊的洞穴裡。那就跟我來吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
I'll follow you. <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Dragon's Nest]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> is in the cave at the right end of the field outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
我會跟著你的。<NAVI>^4D4DFF[龍巢]^000000<INFO>lasa_fild02,340,244,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>就在村莊外田野盡頭的洞穴裡。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The wind is very uneasy today.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
今天的風很不平靜。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
I don't see it near here. We should go deeper!
scripts.translation:
[義警]
附近沒看到。我們應該深入一點！

scripts.text:
[Machie]
......

[Machie]
I may have feigned death, but I am not a coward. It really was huge and frightening. Well, this is not important now. Just go to Tartufi. Tell him that I am sorry that I cannot make it today.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
我雖然裝死，但絕不是膽小鬼。那傢伙真的巨大又可怕。不過現在這不重要。去找塔爾圖菲吧。告訴他我很抱歉，今天去不了了。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Have you taken care of it already? You are fast. I am going to take a rest now. You may go now!
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
你已經處理好了嗎？動作真快。我要休息一下了。你可以走了！

scripts.text:
[Machie]
The Basilisks are acting strange today.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
今天的蛇怪行為很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Argh...

[Vigilante]
Hey! Machie! Wake up! What's going on? Oh, my...
scripts.translation:
[義警]
嘿！瑪琪！醒醒！發生什麼事了？天哪...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Hey! Machie! Wake up! What's going on? didn't you say that you would like to bring your mother from your hometown? You cannot die like this!
scripts.translation:
[義警]
嘿！瑪琪！醒醒！發生什麼事了？你不是說要把你母親從家鄉接過來嗎？你不能就這樣死了！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Didn't you say that you would like to bring your mother from your hometown? You cannot die like this! Hey, buddy! Machie! don't die on me!
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你不是說要把你母親從家鄉接過來嗎？你不能就這樣死了！嘿，夥計！瑪琪！別死在我面前！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Hey, buddy! Machie! don't die on me!
scripts.translation:
[義警]
嘿，夥計！瑪琪！別死在我面前！

scripts.text:
[Machie]
don't kill a person with your words.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
別用言語殺人啊。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Machie?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
瑪琪？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Phew... I tried so hard to fake death. Is it gone now?
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
呼...我裝死裝得很辛苦。現在安全了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
What?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
The most ferocious, heinous and brutal basilisk. This thing was dangerous. It was the scariest basilisk that I had ever seen. I had sprained my ankle out of fear.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
那是最兇猛、最殘忍、最野蠻的蛇怪。那傢伙很危險。是我見過的最可怕的蛇怪。我嚇得腳踝都扭傷了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
So you played dead? Good job. A vigilante should know how to save one's life. Good for you.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
所以你裝死了？幹得好。義警應該知道如何保命。做得不錯。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is the situation that bad?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
情況有那麼糟糕嗎？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Who is this? A newbie?
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
這是誰？新手嗎？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Who is it? Someone from the new continent? A newbie to the Vigilante Corps?
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
是誰？來自新大陸的人？義警部隊的新手？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
No, the adventurer waiting for the sailing. I guess the ship is not setting off because of the fog. This guy came here to check things out.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
不，是那個等著坐船的冒險者。我想是因為霧太大，船沒開。這傢伙來這裡檢視情況。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
I see. Tartufi is causing the trouble again. The basilisks are running wild today.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
看來塔爾圖菲又惹麻煩了。今天那些蛇怪到處亂跑。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
The good weather may have bothered them. Or they could have heard a tune of a flute or something.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
也許是天氣太好讓它們煩躁了。或者它們聽到了笛聲之類的。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Argh... Please hold me a little. I cannot walk properly.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
啊...請扶我一下。我走不太穩。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Dear adventurer, I should take him to the base. Would you be able to go there alone?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
親愛的冒險者，我得帶他去基地。你能獨自去一趟嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
^0000cdTartufi^000000 is right upstairs. Go and ask him what the problem is. He doesn't bite. You don't need to be scared.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
^0000cd塔爾圖菲^000000就在樓上。去問問他怎麼了。他不會咬人的，不用害怕。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I'll go there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我去看看。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
You don't need to rush since the ship won't sail until Tartufi is at peace. Take your time. The ship cannot leave without you.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
不用著急，在塔爾圖菲平靜下來之前船是不會開的。慢慢來，沒有你船是不會走的。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
It sounds very pressuring.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
聽起來壓力好大啊。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Is that so? I just wanted you to take your time. Well, get in there. Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
是嗎？我只是想讓你別急。好了，進去吧。記住，塔爾圖菲的平靜就是海洋的平靜。那意味著希望。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
I am sorry to send you alone!
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
抱歉讓你一個人去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, how can I find the dragon's nest?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我怎麼才能找到龍巢？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
It is hard to miss. You can tell that it is the dragon's nest when you see it. It is located in a high place and very flashy... Well, you can just tell.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
很好找的。看到就知道那是龍巢了。它在一個很高的地方，而且非常顯眼...嗯，你一看就會知道的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I'll be back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我這就回來。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Yes! don't be scared!
scripts.translation:
[義警]
好的！別害怕！

scripts.text:
[Machie]
I heard that ^0000cdan outsider had been messing with the basilisks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
我聽說^0000cd有個外人在招惹那些蛇怪^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess I may have caused it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想可能是我造成的。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
What?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Really?
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
What for? You don't get anything good from hunting down the basilisks.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
為什麼？獵殺蛇怪對你沒有任何好處。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Out of curiosity perhaps. I would poke at everything if I go to the new continent too. Argh... Please hold me a little. I cannot walk properly.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
也許是出於好奇吧。如果我去新大陸，也會到處亂碰的。啊...請扶我一下。我走不太穩。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Dear adventurer, I should take him to the base. Would you be able to go there alone? ^0000cdTartufi^000000 is upstairs. Go and ask him what the problem is.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
親愛的冒險者，我得帶他去基地。你能獨自去一趟嗎？^0000cd塔爾圖菲^000000在樓上。去問問他怎麼了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
I think the adventurer knows what the problem is already.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
我想，這位冒險者已經知道問題出在哪裡了。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
You don't have to say it like that.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
你不用說得那麼直白。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Nothing like this would have happened if that guy just left the basilisks alone. Well, go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
要是那傢伙當初沒去招惹蛇怪，就不會發生這種事了。好了，去吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope. Please ingratiate yourself with Tartufi.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
記住，塔爾圖菲的安寧就是海洋的安寧，它意味著希望。請務必討好塔爾圖菲。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll make sure to resolve the problem.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我會一定解決這個問題的。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
You go ahead and see Tartufi. I'll take Machie with me after taking a rest. Remember, the peace of Tartufi is the peace of the ocean. It means hope.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你先去見塔爾圖菲吧。我休息一會兒後就會帶瑪琪過去。記住，塔爾圖菲的安寧就是海洋的安寧，它意味著希望。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Tartufi must have calmed down. Please go first. I'll go with Machie when he can walk a little. It is too heavy to carry him on my back.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
塔爾圖菲應該已經冷靜下來了。請你先走。等瑪琪能走幾步了，我再跟他過去。揹著他太沉了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Can you stand up?
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你能站起來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Machie]
No. I hope someone carries me on his back...
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
不能。我希望有人能揹我...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
You are saying that for me to hear. don't you even dream of it. I am tired tool.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
你這話是說給我聽的吧？別做夢了。我累死了。

scripts.text:
[Machie]
Tut.
scripts.translation:
[瑪琪]
嘖。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Annoying flies. Annoying mosquitoes. Just annoying. For what fame and riches am I doing here all alone...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
討厭的蒼蠅。討厭的蚊子。真煩人。我孤身一人待在這裡，圖的是什麼名聲和財富...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tartufi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塔爾圖菲？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
You've been troublesome enough. What's up with you all today? You all tiger moths or something?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
你們夠煩人的了。今天到底怎麼回事？你們都是飛蛾撲火嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look, I'm not a basilisk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看，我不是蛇怪。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Who are you? Then again, I've never seen you before... Where's Magchi?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
你是誰？不過，我好像沒見過你...瑪琪呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Magchi was injured during a patrol and went back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
瑪琪在巡邏時受傷了，已經回去了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Oh no. What happened?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
哦不。發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A huge basilisk appeared and he was so startled that he injured his leg. Another vigilante took him, so I'm sure he returned safely.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
出現了一隻巨大的蛇怪，他嚇壞了，傷了腿。另一位義警帶他走了，我相信他應該安全回去了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Yeah? Then I guess he's not dead. I was always curious about the rest of the story that Magchi used to tell me every day. Oh, do you that story too?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
是嗎？那他應該沒死。我一直很好奇瑪琪每天講給我的那個故事的後續。哦，你也知道那個故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
It's [I Witnessed a Murder on the Evening of Full Moon]. Tell me, if you know the story.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
故事叫《滿月之夜的謀殺目擊者》。如果你知道的話，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No clue. I've never heard of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
完全不知道。我從來沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Really? Then did Magchi make up that story? And are you going to take care of them?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
真的嗎？那瑪琪是在編故事嗎？還有，你要去照顧它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
照顧什麼？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Magchi used to fight off the basilisks that came this way every day. Without Magchi, they're being troublesome today. So annoying.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
瑪琪以前每天都會趕走那些從這邊來的蛇怪。沒有瑪琪，它們今天就很麻煩。真煩人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So That's why you're breathing out fire.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來你噴火是為了這個。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Because it keeps them away for now.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
因為這樣能暫時把它們嚇走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The port is smothered in fog because of that smoke. So I came to investigate since the boats can't set sail.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
港口因為那些煙霧被濃霧籠罩了。所以船無法起航，我來調查一下。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Set sail? Then are you an adventurer? I heard from Magchi that a new world has been discovered. An unknown land where no one has gone before. I wish I can go, too.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
起航？那你就是冒險者嗎？我聽瑪琪說發現了一個新世界。那是無人踏足過的未知土地。我也想去看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can go right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你現在就可以去。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
No. My mom and dad left just recently. I must stay here and grow up a bit more. Sleep a lot and eat a lot. Once I become strong and tough, I'll go for a sightseeing.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
不行。我爸爸媽媽剛剛離開。我必須留在這裡再長大一點。多睡點覺，多吃點東西。等我變得強壯結實了，再去觀光。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're this big and still call yourself a child?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你都這麼大了，還自稱孩子？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
don't call me a little child though. I'm only 457 years old. But then again, I'm a child compared to grandpa hiding somewhere over there.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
別叫我小孩子。我才457歲。不過和躲在那邊某處的爺爺比起來，我還是個小孩子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Grandpa? Who?

[Tartufi]
He's ^0000cdImoogi^000000, somewhat of a basilisk chief. But I don't know. He's complaining about how if it weren't for ^0000cdmy mom and dad, he would've ascended to heaven already^000000. So he always has basilisks on loose to harass me.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
他是^0000cd伊莫吉^000000，算是蛇怪的首領。不過我也不太清楚。他總是在抱怨，要不是有^0000cd我爸媽^000000，他早就昇天去了。所以他總是放蛇怪出來騷擾我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh my.

[Tartufi]
Oh! There are basilisks coming this way again. Please, take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
哦！又有蛇怪朝這邊來了。拜託，請處理掉它們。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Well, Magchi used to wield some type of long pole. Maybe that would do. ^0000cdAt least 20^000000 must be taken care of before they run away.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
嗯，瑪琪以前用一種長杆武器。也許那會有用。在它們逃跑之前，至少要處理掉^0000cd20^000000只。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I picked up a few things so let me give them a try. Wait.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我撿了一些東西，讓我試試。等等。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
They just never give up, do they? But you must try a little harder. They're nowhere near done because they know that you're weak. So you must show your strong side!
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
它們就是不肯放棄，對吧？但你要更努力一點。它們還沒完，因為它們知道你很弱。所以你必須展現出強大的一面！

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
They'll be quiet for a while if you show them that you're strong. So try a little harder. I'll help you.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
如果你向它們展示你的強大，它們就會安靜一會兒。所以再努力一點吧。我會幫你的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Is he gone? I guess he is. That ought to keep them quiet for a while. Got me all worried at first because he said he was a rookie adventurer, but he should be able to pull off one doram's bit.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
他走了嗎？我想是的。這樣它們應該會安靜一會兒。一開始我很擔心，因為他說是個新手冒險者，但他應該能應付一隻多蘭的把戲。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everyone treats me like a new eggring, but I've also completed a formal training course!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家都把我當成剛出生的蛋黃波利，但我可是完成過正規訓練課程的！

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Magchi tells me that It's a short, intensive program. But would that be enough? You went through a hell of a training while taking down those basilisks, so you're no longer a rookie.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
瑪琪告訴我，那只是一個短期的強化課程。但那足夠嗎？你在擊敗那些蛇怪時經歷了地獄般的訓練，所以你不再是新手了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, yeah. Thanks.

[Tartufi]
By the time he's ready to run around again, Magchi will come. Thanks a lot. You said you're heading for an adventure in the new world? Tell me about the new world when you're in Lasagna time to time.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
等他準備好再次行動時，瑪琪就會來。非常感謝。你說你要去新世界冒險？等你在羅札納有空的時候，跟我講講新世界吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will. Farewell, then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會的。那麼，再見。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
It was short, but I really enjoyed your being here. Goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
雖然時間很短，但我真的很高興你能來。再見。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Zzz... zzz...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
呼...呼...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It must be somewhere near here that can communicate with Imoogi.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡附近一定有什麼地方能與伊穆克溝通。

scripts.text:
[???]
Who are you?

[{0}]
A g-ghost?

[???]
How dare you treat me like a ghost! I have lived for ^0000cd2,500 years^000000!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你竟敢把我當成幽靈！我已經活了^0000cd2,500年^000000了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oww...that hurts. I'm sorry if I've offended you, but are you Imoogi, the chief of the Basilisk?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎喲...好痛。抱歉如果冒犯到你了，但你是蛇怪的首領伊穆克嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
Your language is as vulgar as your appearance.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
你的言語和你的外表一樣粗俗。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's what Tartufi said.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是塔爾圖菲說的。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
He's young and foolish from lack of learning. I am Imook. I am called ^0000cdLord Imuk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
他年輕無知，缺乏學識。我是伊穆克。人們稱我為^0000cd伊穆克大人^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lord Imuk... Did you say you lived for 2,500 years?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
伊穆克大人...你說你活了2,500年？

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
Yes. And I was supposed to ^0000cdbecome a dragon and ascend to heaven^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
是的。而且我本應^0000cd化身為龍並昇天^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ascend? You mean going up to the heaven?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
昇天？你是說升到天上嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
I can ^0000cdascend to heaven by training for 1,000 years and becoming a dragon^000000. But the ^0000cdmother and father of that young one^000000 snatched ^0000cdYeouiju^000000 twice in the past and ascended instead.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
我本可以^0000cd修煉一千年，化身為龍並昇天^000000。但那個年輕人的^0000cd父母^000000過去曾兩次搶奪^0000cd延久^000000，並代替我昇天了。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
And now, that young one is hiding Yeouiju somewhere and seeking for a chance to ascend after 500 years. I will regain what's mine. My rights are justified.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
現在，那個年輕人把延久藏了起來，正伺機在500年後昇天。我要奪回屬於我的東西。我的權利是正當的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Seems like Yeouiju is a must-have in order to become a dragon. Is that why the basilisks are bothering Tartufi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來延久是化身為龍的必需品。這就是為什麼蠑螈一直在騷擾塔爾圖菲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
The ^0000cdbasilisks are charged with the task of recovering Yeouiju^000000.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
^0000cd蠑螈被賦予了奪回延久的任務^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You see, Tartufi breathes fire when he's attacked, and the smoke smothers the town. This keeps people from traveling freely.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看，塔爾圖菲被攻擊時會噴火，煙霧會籠罩城鎮。這讓人們無法自由出行。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
I'm sorry to hear that. But that young one is at fault. Basilisks will continue with their task until the Yeouiju is recovered.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
聽到這個我很遺憾。但錯在那個年輕人。在奪回延久之前，蠑螈會繼續執行任務。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mm... I understand. So you have no intention of giving up until you get that Yeouiju. I'll ask Tartufi about Yeouiju.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我明白了。看來在你拿到延久之前是不會罷休的。我會去問問塔爾圖菲關於延久的事。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
Thanks. Now I must continue with my training so do not disturb me and go away.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
謝謝。現在我要繼續修煉了，不要打擾我，請離開。

scripts.text:
[Lord Imuk]
Tell the young one about Yeouiju. I must continue with my training so do not disturb me and go away.
scripts.translation:
[伊穆克大人]
告訴那個年輕人關於延久的事。我要繼續修煉了，不要打擾我，請離開。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Annoying flies. Annoying mosquitoes. Just annoying. I miss mom and dad.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
討厭的蒼蠅。討厭的蚊子。真煩人。我想爸爸媽媽了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tartufi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塔爾圖菲？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
You've been troublesome enough. What's up with you all today? Tiger strike wasn't enough? You all tiger moths or something?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
你們已經夠煩人的了。今天怎麼都這麼不對勁？老虎撲擊還不夠嗎？你們都是老虎蛾嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Look, I'm not a basilisk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看，我不是蛇怪。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Who are you? Your clothes are weird and you look weird. Where did Magchi go?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
你是誰？你的衣服很奇怪，樣子也很奇怪。馬吉去哪了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Magchi was injured during a patrol and went back. And I'm from the new world.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
馬吉在巡邏時受傷回去了。我來自新世界。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I see. You're from the new world. But what about Magchi?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
原來如此。你來自新世界。但是馬吉呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Basilisks went on a rampage and he injured his leg. Another vigilante took him, so I'm sure he returned safely.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
蠑螈發狂了，他傷了腿。另一位義警帶走了他，我相信他安全返回了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Yeah? Then That's a relief. But I don't know what's gotten into these creatures. They were quiet just until now.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
是嗎？那就好。但我不知道這些生物怎麼了。直到剛才它們都很安靜。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I was after the basilisks just before.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我剛才一直在追那些蠑螈。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
What? You went after the basilisks? You?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
什麼？你去追蠑螈了？你？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh... yes. I'm sorry. I didn't mean to.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃...是的。對不起。我不是故意的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
No, no. I'm not saying what you did was wrong. But can you tell me more about that?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
不，不。我不是說你做錯了什麼。但你能多告訴我一些關於那件事的情況嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was asked to find some basils. I heard that I can find them from the basilisks, so I came all the way here to catch them. I guess that must've excited them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我受命去尋找一些羅勒。聽說可以從蠑螈身上找到，所以我一路來到這裡捕捉它們。我想那一定讓它們很興奮。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I see. Then are you strong? You said you caught some basilisks.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
我明白了。那你很強嗎？你說你捕捉了一些蠑螈。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess you can say that...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我想你可以這麼說...

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Magchi just drove off the basilisks that came this way every day. That was enough, but without Magchi, they are bothering me again. So annoying.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
馬奇只是趕走了每天朝這邊來的蠑螈。那樣就足夠了，但沒有馬奇，它們又來找我的麻煩了。真煩人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So That's why you're breathing out fire.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來你噴火是為了這個。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Because it keeps them away for now.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
因為這樣能暫時把它們嚇走。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The port is smothered in fog because of that smoke. So I came to investigate since the boats can't set sail.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
港口因為那些煙霧被濃霧籠罩了。所以船無法起航，我來調查一下。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Set sail? Ah, right. You said you were from the new world. Then can I ask for a favor? Please tell their ^0000cdchief^000000 to keep them quiet.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
揚帆起航？啊，對。你說你是來自新世界的。那麼我能請你幫個忙嗎？請告訴他們的^0000cd首領^000000讓它們安靜點。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
His name is Imoogi. I don't know where he lives, but there's something ^0000cdup there that can communicate with Imoogi^000000. Basilisks go there every morning and hear something...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
他的名字叫伊穆克。我不知道他住在哪裡，但那裡有^0000cd某種能與伊穆克溝通的東西^000000。蠑螈每天早上都會去那裡聽一些東西...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Sorry about the basilisks. I'll take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。抱歉關於蠑螈的事。我會處理好的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Okay. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
好的。回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Did you get to talk with Imoogi? What did he say? Not yet? Hurry up. The basilisks are so annoying.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
你和伊穆克談過了嗎？他說了什麼？還沒嗎？快點。蠑螈太煩人了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
You here. So how did it go?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
你來了。那麼情況如何？

scripts.text: [You tell Tartufi about the story of Lord Imuk and Yeouiju.]
scripts.translation: [你向塔爾圖菲講述了伊穆克大人與如意珠的故事。]

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Yeouiju? What's that?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
如意珠？那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not exactly sure, but It's a must-have to become a dragon and ascend to the heaven.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不太確定，但它是變成龍並昇天所必需的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Whatever it is, I'll look for it. It should take some time to look for it here somewhere. But in the meanwhile, can you take care of them?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
不管它是什麼，我會去找的。在這裡找它可能需要一些時間。但在此期間，你能照顧一下它們嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will. How long would it take?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會的。需要多久？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I don't know. Perhaps 200 years or so?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
我不知道。也許200年左右？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Think about it. It takes about that much time to search through everything here. On top of that, I don't even know what Yeouiju is.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
想想看。在這裡搜尋所有東西大約需要那麼長時間。而且，我甚至不知道如意珠是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Anyway, I'll look for it, so you take care of them. Just today. Tomorrow, perhaps Magchi will come and get rid of them. But today, you do it. I heard It's because of you.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
總之，我會去找它的，所以你去照顧它們。就今天。明天，也許馬奇會來把它們趕走。但今天，由你來。我聽說這是因為你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine. If you by any chance find that Yeouiju, please tell Lord Imuk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。如果你碰巧找到了如意珠，請告訴伊穆克大人。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I'll think about it. I don't even know what that is. I can't promise you without knowing what it is.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
我會考慮的。我甚至不知道那是什麼。在不知道它是什麼的情況下，我無法向你保證。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess you're right. I can't wait forever so I should get rid of those basilisks. How many should I take care of?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說得對。我不能永遠等下去，所以我應該解決那些蛇怪。我需要處理多少隻？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Get rid of ^0000cd20 or so^000000 and they won't come near from fear.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
解決掉^0000cd20只左右^000000，它們就會因為恐懼而不敢靠近了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine. If you by any chance find that Yeouiju, please tell Lord Imuk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的。如果你碰巧找到了如意珠，請告訴伊穆克大人。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
No, not yet. They keep coming. I said not yet.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
不，還沒完。它們還在不斷出現。我說了還沒完。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Did you forget? You must get rid of at least 20 basilisks before they get quiet.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
你忘了嗎？在它們安靜下來之前，你必須至少解決掉20只蛇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whew. All taken care of.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呼。都處理好了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Good job. That should keep them quiet now. I'm going to look through my treasure but I need to sleep first. I'm sleepy cuz I've been up for so long today.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
幹得好。現在它們應該安靜了。我要去翻找我的寶物，但我得先睡一覺。因為我今天醒得太久，很困。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'm sure Lord Imuk will wait as well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我相信伊穆克大人也會等待的。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Fine. You're boarding on a ship, right? I hope you get to your destination safely.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
好的。你正要上船，對吧？祝你平安抵達目的地。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks. I think I can sail off in a nice weather.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝。我想天氣不錯，可以出發了。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
No prob. Farewell, then.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
不客氣。那麼，再見。

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
I heard you're boarding on a ship. Shouldn't you hurry?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
聽說你要上船。你不該快點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tartufi]
Zzz... zzz...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾圖菲]
呼...呼...

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
Only the vigilantes can eat here.
scripts.translation:
義警廚師
只有義警才能在這裡用餐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello.

[Chief Peperoncino]
You're from our adventurers' club {0} Aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
你是來自我們冒險者俱樂部{0}的人，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
You're from the new world? What does a person from the new world want with me?
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
你是來自新世界的？一個來自新世界的人找我有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You remember me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你記得我。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
I remember everyone that I've crossed paths with.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
我記得每一個與我擦肩而過的人。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Besides seeking for new adventures, listening to other people's stories is an adventurer's duty. From what I gather, you've been in Lasagna longer than most people.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
除了尋找新的冒險，傾聽他人的故事也是冒險者的職責。據我瞭解，你在羅札納待的時間比大多數人都長。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everyone recommended that I should ask you for stories on Lasagna and Farfalle Vigilantes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家都建議我來向你打聽關於羅札納和法爾法雷義警的故事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
Listening to other people's adventure stories is one of the virtues of an adventurer. If you can listen carefully and learn something from other people, they'll be valuable lessons on life.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
傾聽他人的冒險故事是冒險者的美德之一。如果你能仔細聆聽，並從他人身上學到東西，那將是寶貴的人生經驗。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
So what are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
那麼，你對什麼感到好奇呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
