I'm curious about your story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很好奇你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
My story... Why are you curious? But since you asked, I'll tell you. I was born outside of Lasagna called ^0000cdFusilli^000000. Back then, you mention the name Peperoncino and everyone in Fusilli knew.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
我的故事... 你為什麼好奇？不過既然你問了，我就告訴你。我出生在羅札納之外的^0000cd富西利^000000。那時候，只要提到佩佩龍奇諾這個名字，富西利的人都知道。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante]
Sir, That's not what you said the last time we talked over a drink. You said you left because you hated being looked down upon due to poverty.
scripts.translation:
[義警]
先生，這和你上次喝酒時說的不一樣。你當時說，你離開是因為討厭因為貧窮而被看不起。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
What are you talking about? You must've been very drunk that day. What more can an adventurer ask for when you get to experience so many things in a vast ocean?
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
你在說什麼？那天你肯定喝醉了。在廣闊的大海上體驗了這麼多事情，一個冒險者還能要求什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
But unfortunately, ^0000cdI became unable to be on a ship^000000. I can't tell you why. It's classified information.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
但不幸的是，^0000cd我變得無法上船了^000000。我不能告訴你原因。這是機密資訊。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
Seasickness.
scripts.translation:
義警 廚師
暈船。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Then I saw the unlimited potential of fishing industry, or anchovy manufacturing to be more exact. So I jumped into the ^0000cdanchovy manufacturing business^000000. And I met Gamberry around that time.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
然後我看到了漁業無限的潛力，或者更確切地說是鯷魚製造業。於是我投身於^0000cd鯷魚製造業^000000。就在那時，我遇到了甘貝利。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
^0000cdGamberry was a hoodlum who reminded me of a ruffian^000000. He soon was moved by my words and joined me in the business.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
^0000cd甘貝利是個讓我想起惡棍的混混^000000。他很快被我的話打動，加入了我的事業。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
I heard you guys fought.
scripts.translation:
義警 廚師
我聽說你們打過架。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Of course there were small disputes, but Gamberry was moved by my leadership and became influenced. After we gained enough experience and know-hows from anchovy manufacturing, we decided to draw a bigger picture.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
當然有一些小爭執，但甘貝利被我的領導力所打動，並受到了影響。在我們從鯷魚製造業中積累了足夠的經驗和知識後，我們決定畫一個更大的藍圖。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
It was ^0000cdselling specialty products^000000. Gamberry's friend ^0000cdThomas^000000 joined the venture and we decided to start the business in Lasagna. But the problem was ^0000cdlousy dorams^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
那就是^0000cd銷售特色產品^000000。甘貝利的朋友^0000cd托馬斯^000000加入了這項事業，我們決定在羅札納開始生意。但問題是^0000cd糟糕的多蘭^000000。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
They would pick on every single thing so I decided to catch them and make them work.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
他們對每件事都挑三揀四，所以我決定抓住他們，讓他們工作。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
That story doesn't add up.
scripts.translation:
義警 廚師
這個故事對不上。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
At any rate, Captain Gamberry is a good man. He was influenced by me since his ragtag days and now he's become a doram.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
無論如何，甘貝利船長是個好人。他從我落魄的時候就受到了我的影響，現在他成了一個多蘭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How was Lasagna in the past?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
過去的羅札納是什麼樣的？

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Lasagna was just awful when I first came here. You breathe and someone picks a fight. You walk and fights break out. Captain Gamberry went around putting the brakes on those crowds, but my first impression of him was no different from them.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
我剛來羅札納時，這裡簡直糟透了。你呼吸一下，就有人找茬。你走一步，就爆發打架。甘貝利船長四處奔走，試圖阻止那些人群，但我對他的第一印象和他們沒什麼不同。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
If violence subdues violence, then what will subdue that violence? Anyway, Lasagna was like a rotten trash can. In comparison, Fusilli is a town with totally innocent people!
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
如果暴力能壓制暴力，那麼什麼能壓制那種暴力呢？總之，羅札納就像一個腐朽的垃圾桶。相比之下，富西利是一個完全由無辜的人組成的城鎮！

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
I ask the newcomers about Fusilli and none of them knows. It must be in the backwoods or something.
scripts.translation:
義警 廚師
我問過新來的人關於富西利的事，他們都不知道。那地方肯定是在什麼偏僻的荒野裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Anyhow, the biggest obstacle when we started the business was Lasagna's lousy dorams. They pounced on me for a fight. Is everyone who live by sea so belligerent like that?
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
總之，我們剛開始做生意時，最大的障礙就是羅札納那些糟糕的多蘭。他們總是撲上來找架打。難道所有靠海為生的人都這麼好鬥嗎？

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
No, don't insult them. It's this place That's unusual.
scripts.translation:
義警 廚師
不，別侮辱他們。是這個地方才不正常。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
At first, I tried to persuade those lousy dorams through conversation. I tried to be a gentleman but they wouldn't listen. That's when Gamberry took the matters into his own hands.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
起初，我試著通過對話來說服那些糟糕的多蘭。我試圖表現得像個紳士，但他們根本不聽。就在那時，甘貝利親自出手了。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
didn't I tell you just before? He took care of it completely. I gathered those lousy dorams and spoke to them. They were so touched by my speech that they volunteered to join the vigilance corps.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
我不是剛跟你說過嗎？他徹底解決了這件事。我把那些糟糕的多蘭召集起來跟他們談話。他們被我的演講深深打動了，主動申請加入義警隊。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Hmph! Anyway, with the efforts of vigilance corps and merchants, Lasagna was reborn to its current state.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
哼！總之，在義警隊和商人的共同努力下，羅札納才重生為現在的樣子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How are the vigilance corps and merchants?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
義警隊和商人現在怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
The ^0000cdvigilance corps and merchants^000000 are... um... Among several organizations that run Lasagna, you can say that the two created today's Lasagna. And Gamberry, Thomas, and I were at the heart of it.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
^0000cd義警隊和商人^000000嘛... 嗯... 在管理羅札納的幾個組織中，可以說正是這兩者造就了今天的羅札納。而甘貝利、托馬斯和我，則是其中的核心。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
When we jumped into the specialty product business, many dorams who were moved by us wanted to help.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
當我們投身於特產生意時，許多被我們感動的多蘭都想要幫忙。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
See what I mean? Different version from the last.
scripts.translation:
義警 廚師
你懂我的意思嗎？這和剛才說的版本不一樣啊。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
We gathered those lousy dorams and sent them to the vigilance corps and merchants. Lasagna's ^0000cdmaintenance of order was handled by the vigilantes^000000, and ^0000cdeverything related to the products was handled by the merchants^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
我們召集了那些糟糕的多蘭，把他們分派到義警隊和商人那裡。羅札納的^0000cd秩序維護由義警負責^000000，而^0000cd與產品相關的一切事務則由商人負責^000000。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
To expand our flourishing business, we ^0000cdbegan sea trade^000000. But during this time, ^0000cdThomas's ship Butterfly went missing in a typhoon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
為了擴大我們蓬勃發展的生意，我們^0000cd開始了海上貿易^000000。但在此期間，^0000cd托馬斯的船“蝴蝶號”在臺風中失蹤了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
I ^0000cdpersistently persuaded the captain and crewmen of Con-Chliina to find Butterfly^000000. My efforts finally paid off and we found them on a ^0000cdremote island in the new world^000000.
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
我^0000cd堅持不懈地勸說“康克里納號”的船長和船員去尋找“蝴蝶號”^000000。我的努力終於有了回報，我們在^0000cd新世界的偏僻島上^000000找到了他們。

scripts.text:
Vigilante Chef
Well, that was Stello of Con-Chliina...
scripts.translation:
義警 廚師
嗯，那是“康克里納號”的斯特洛...

scripts.text:
[Peperoncino]
Anything else you're curious about?
scripts.translation:
[佩佩龍奇諾]
你還有什麼好奇的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That was... what an amazing adventure. Thank you for sharing your story. I can clearly see where your dignified manner comes from.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那真是... 一段驚人的冒險。謝謝你分享你的故事。我現在能明白你為何如此莊重了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thank you for your time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你的時間。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
I hope I can listen to your story one day.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
希望有一天能聽到你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Chief Peperoncino]
I hope I can listen to your story one day.
scripts.translation:
[首領 佩佩龍奇諾]
希望有一天能聽到你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Who's is it? Who's there?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
是誰？誰在那兒？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wow, you have an amazing sensing ability.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇，你的感知能力真強。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
When you live alone for a long time, you get sensitive to the slightest noise. So what brings you here? I'm out of kaluna milk right now. Do you want to order something else?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
一個人住久了，對細微的聲響都會變得敏感。
所以，是什麼風把你吹來了？
我現在正好沒有卡魯納牛奶了。
你想點別的嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
there's something I wanted to ask you. Do you remember anything about Captain Gamberry and Chief Peperoncino?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實我有件事想問你。
你還記得船長甘貝里和首領佩佩龍奇諾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, those eggring boys. Speaking of which, I haven't seen them much lately. Did they give up and leave Lasagna?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦，是那群蛋黃波利小子。
說起來，我最近都沒怎麼見到他們。
他們是放棄這裡，離開羅札納了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, they're both well and still in Lasagna. I'm here because there is something I wanted to know about Captain Gamberry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，他們都很好，還留在羅札納。
我來這裡是因為我想知道一些關於船長甘貝里的事。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Captain? Captain who? Gamberry? That eggring boy? Oh, you're right. He did become a captain. I remember when he showed up in my pub with Pepe.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
船長？哪個船長？甘貝里？
那個蛋黃波利小子？
啊，你說得對。他確實成了船長。
我記得他帶著佩佩來到我酒館的時候。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pepe?

[Grandma]
^0000cdPepe. Peperoncino. Gamberry is Berry, and Tomei Thomas is Toto^000000. I guess young people don't know. Anyway, they were like wild basilisks.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
^0000cd佩佩。佩佩龍奇諾。甘貝里是貝瑞，托梅·托馬斯是托托^000000。
我想現在的年輕人都不知道了。
反正，他們當時就像一群野生的巴希利斯克。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Are the basilisks still in the cave? When we were young, we didn't even go near the cave.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
那些巴希利斯克還在洞穴裡嗎？
我們年輕的時候，連洞穴附近都不敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what happened then? They showed up at the pub and what did they do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那後來發生了什麼？
他們來到酒館後做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, right. Pepe looked like a homeless and ordered kaluna milk. That's when Berry picked a fight, saying that only the kids have it shaken.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦，對了。佩佩當時看起來像個流浪漢，點了卡魯納牛奶。
就是那時候，貝瑞挑起了事端，說只有小孩子才喝加奶的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
So they ^0000cdfought^000000. My ^0000cdstore was destroyed^000000. So I made a ^0000cdclaim for damages^000000 for broken furniture and profit loss until the pub was back in business.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
於是他們^0000cd打了起來^000000。
我的^0000cd店被砸了^000000。
所以我提交了^0000cd損害賠償申請^000000，包括傢俱損壞和酒館停業期間的利潤損失。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
You mentioned Pepe. Seemed like he was poor there as well. He came to Lasagna after hearing from somewhere that he can make a lot of money on anchovy fishing boat, but quit because of seasickness.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你提到了佩佩。看來他那時候也很窮。
他聽說在鯷魚船上能賺大錢，就來到了羅札納，但因為暈船而辭職了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
After that, he couldn't get on a boat ever again. Haha. He became indebted because of the ^0000cdpenalty for breach of contract^000000 and couldn't leave. So he ended up in the anchovy workshop where he removes anchovy head and guts...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
從那以後，他就再也上不了船了。哈哈。
他因為^0000cd違約罰金^000000而負債累累，無法離開。
最後他只好在鯷魚工坊工作，負責去頭去內臟...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Anyway, he had a huge debt from the boat and pub. The two mulled over what to do and ended up at the ^0000cdanchovy workshop^000000. Few years later, ^0000cdGamberry became the workshop manager^000000. The job was perfect for him.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
總之，他欠了船費和酒館的債。
兩人商量後，最終去了^0000cd鯷魚工坊^000000。
幾年後，^0000cd甘貝里成了工坊管理員^000000。
這份工作非常適合他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How was Lasagna in the old days?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
以前的羅札納是什麼樣的？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
don't even mention it. It was a mess. The roads were awful. People were awful. there's a reason why the past is called the dark ages.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
別提了。那時候簡直是一團糟。
路很爛，人也很爛。
過去被稱為“黑暗時代”是有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Have you ever stepped on fish guts on a road? That's how Lasagna was back then.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你曾在路上踩過魚內臟嗎？
以前的羅札納就是那樣的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Then one day, two roughnecks came up with the merchants and vigilance corps and started beating up Lasagna kids.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
然後有一天，兩個粗漢帶著商人和治安隊，開始毆打羅札納的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I guess sticks do make dorams. The two sent those hoodlums to the merchants and vigilance corps. Mm... I remember those boys. Their beards were cut and tails were tattered.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
看來棍棒確實能造就多蘭。
那兩人把那些流氓交給了商人和治安隊。
嗯...我記得那兩個男孩。他們的鬍子被剃了，尾巴也被剪禿了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Those doram mouse-looking ones all left Lasagna and only the ones who wanted to live a decent life stayed. They're the ones who made current Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
那些看起來像多蘭老鼠的傢伙都離開了羅札納，只有想好好生活的人留了下來。
是他們造就了現在的羅札納。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
But who are you? Did you come to order kaluna milk? Stirred or shaken? Where did all my workers go?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
不過你是誰？你是來點卡魯納牛奶的嗎？攪拌還是搖勻？我的工人們都去哪了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll get going now...

[Grandma]
With no customers, my pub will soon be out of business.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
沒有顧客的話，我的酒館很快就要倒閉了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
If you're not going to order anything, get the heck out!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
如果你不打算點單，就給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Zzz...zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
呼...呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
It looks huge and heavy. Go and get rid of some.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
它看起來又大又重。去處理掉一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
If you wish to speak to me, then you'd better go and get some more experience.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
如果你想和我對話，最好先去多積攢一些經驗值。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A glass of kaluna milk please.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請給我一杯卡魯納牛奶。

scripts.text: Stirred.
scripts.translation: 攪拌

scripts.text: Shaken.
scripts.translation: 搖勻

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
If you want to drink kaluna milk, then go see the guy next door. But you'd better hurry. Stirred or shaken, that won't matter pretty soon.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
如果你想喝卡魯納牛奶，就去隔壁找那個傢伙。不過你最好快點。不管是攪拌還是搖勻，很快就沒區別了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You know what the main ingredients of kaluna milk are? They're ^0000cdkaluna^000000, the essence made from fermenting a special shellfish called ^0000cdkalunyak^000000, and fresh milk.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
你知道卡魯納牛奶的主要原料是什麼嗎？是^0000cd卡魯納^000000，一種由名為^0000cd卡魯尼亞克^000000的特殊貝殼魔靈發酵製成的精華，以及新鮮牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Mix that in moderate temperate and garnish with a gooseberry. And then you get the kaluna milk that everyone loves.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
將它們以適中的溫度混合，再點綴一顆鵝莓。這樣就能做出大家都愛的卡魯納牛奶了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
But we're almost finished with the kaluna in store and the person who supplies us hasn't been here for days. Even the ones we had in stockpile are nearly gone.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
但我們庫存的卡魯納快用完了，供應商好幾天沒來過了。就連儲備的那些也快見底了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Without kaluna, there's no kaluna milk. You get what that means?
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
沒有卡魯納，就沒有卡魯納牛奶。你明白這意味著什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What does it mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這意味著什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
It means customers who came for kaluna milk would have made their trip in vain.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
這意味著那些為了喝卡魯納牛奶而來的人，將白跑一趟。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Angry people who didn't get to drink kaluna milk will soon cause a ^0000cdriot^000000, and soon it will spread over the entire Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
喝不到卡魯納牛奶的憤怒人群很快就會引發^0000cd暴動^000000，而且很快會蔓延到整個羅札納。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Then Lasagna will return to its former state of filth and danger. I can't let that happen. We're finally living like decent human beings but to go back to that dark age...
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
那樣羅札納就會回到過去骯髒和危險的狀態。我不能讓這種事發生。我們終於能像正常人一樣生活了，卻又要回到那個黑暗時代...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sure that won't happen just over a glass of kaluna milk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我相信不會僅僅因為一杯卡魯納牛奶就發生那種事。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You don't understand what kaluna milk means for people of Lasagna. It's not merely a drink that relaxes the body for these people.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
你不懂卡魯納牛奶對羅札納人意味著什麼。對他們來說，這不僅僅是一杯能放鬆身體的飲品。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Kaluna milk also symbolizes ^0000cdfaith and friendship, as well as festival^000000. I can't discuss the details here, but if you're curious, go see the bookkeeper of Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
卡魯納牛奶還象徵著^0000cd信任、友誼以及節日^000000。這裡不方便細說，如果你好奇，可以去問問康-奇利納的記賬員。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
He's a recording maniac who loves to record everything.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
他是個記錄狂人，喜歡把一切都記錄下來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not exactly sure, but I can tell It's really important for people here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不太確定，但我能感覺到這對這裡的人來說非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Right. That's what I'm talking about. You always start or finish the day with kaluna milk. But that kaluna is nearly all gone!
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
沒錯，我就是這個意思。人們總是以卡魯納牛奶開始或結束一天。但現在卡魯納幾乎都喝光了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you send someone over and find out what happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你為什麼不派個人去調查一下發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I'm not dumb you know. But there's no one to send! Look, everyone is busy.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
我又不是傻子。但是沒人可派啊！你看，大家都忙得很。

scripts.text: I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 我來幫你。

scripts.text: Oh no. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Yeah, I'm busy so you should get going. If you wish to drink kaluna milk, try the next door.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
是啊，我很忙，所以你也該走了。如果你想喝卡魯納牛奶，試試隔壁吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
What? What did you just say? If I heard you correctly, you said you'd help me.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
什麼？你剛才說什麼？如果我沒聽錯的話，你說你會幫我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You heard me right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你沒聽錯。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Dear lord, thank you. So this is how you repay me for all the nice deeds I've done.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
天哪，謝謝你。原來這就是你報答我所有善舉的方式嗎。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one who said I'll help you, but how come the lord gets the appreciation?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明明是我說要幫你的，怎麼感謝的是主啊？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Oh, not at all. I'm grateful to you, too. Anyways, if you go to the ^0000cdfishing hole near the south bridge^000000, you'll meet ^0000cdLegalas^000000 who is standing on crutches. He's the one who supplies us with kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
哦，不不不。我也很感激你。總之，如果你去^0000cd南橋附近的漁場^000000，會遇到拄著柺杖的^0000cd萊加拉斯^000000。他就是給我們供應卡魯納的人。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Most people in Lasagna work for the vigilante corps or merchants, so the town is always short on hands.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
羅札納的大多數人都為義警部隊或商人工作，所以鎮上總是人手不足。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
So we hire outsiders who want a job as a special treatment policy, and Legalas is in charge of fermenting kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
所以我們作為特殊政策僱傭想工作的外地人，萊加拉斯負責發酵卡魯納。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
He's quite skilled at catching, cleaning, and fermenting kalunyak that Lasagna's kaluna milk is regarded as the best around here. Ah, this is not the important part.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
他在捕捉、清洗和發酵卡魯納克方面非常熟練，羅札納的卡魯納牛奶被認為是這一帶最好的。啊，這不是重點。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Go find Legalas and find out what's going on. And tell him to make delivery as soon as possible. At the rate we're going, we'll be out of stock after today.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
去找萊加拉斯，弄清楚發生了什麼。並告訴他儘快送貨。照這個速度，今天之後我們就斷貨了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, I'll go and find out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我去看看。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
非常感謝！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Didn't you say you were going to find out why Legalas was not able to make the delivery?
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
你剛才不是說要去看看萊加拉斯為什麼沒能送貨嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I beg you. I'm really worried. Can't even sleep these days.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
拜託了。我真的非常擔心，這幾天都睡不著覺。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Adventurer, what did Legalas say? Did he say he can deliver kaluna?
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
冒險者，萊加拉斯怎麼說？他有沒有說能送來卡魯納？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Fortunately, he said he's close to meeting the delivery quota.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。幸運的是，他說他快要達到送貨配額了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
What a relief! But did tell you about what caused him the delay?
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
真是鬆了一口氣！不過，他有沒有告訴你是什麼導致了延誤？

scripts.text: [You tell Kalu about the story of Daldal and Gopara.]
scripts.translation: [你向卡盧講述了達爾達爾與戈帕拉的故事。]

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
So what you're telling is that I should keep the two far away from the workshop while Legalas is working.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
所以你的意思是，在萊加拉斯工作的時候，我要把這兩個傢伙遠遠地趕出工坊。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I think That's something I can take care of. As a matter of fact, I have a ^0000cdlunchbox delivery to make inside the cave^000000. Every day, that is.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
我覺得這事我可以搞定。事實上，我每天都要往洞穴裡送一次^0000cd午餐盒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Looks like the two can be sent to the delivery team while Legalas is working. For wage, a meal per day would do.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
看來可以讓這兩個傢伙加入送貨隊，在萊加拉斯工作時替我跑腿。作為報酬，每天管一頓飯就行。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Cave? That's nice. I've always wanted to go there myself.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
洞穴？聽起來不錯。我一直都想去那裡看看。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Whatever it is, I'm happy that I get to eat yummy food.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
不管是什麼，只要能有好吃的美食，我就開心。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Okay, then Let's get started right away! Take this lunchbox to the ^0000cdvigilante inside the cave. His name is Panna.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
好，那就馬上開始！把這個午餐盒送到洞穴裡的^0000cd義警^000000那裡。他叫潘娜。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我們走。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Get up.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
快起來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
M-me, too?

[Gopara]
We're a team.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我們是一個團隊。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
A team must move as one.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
團隊必須行動一致。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since when was I part of the team? All right, fine... Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什麼時候成團隊的一員了？好吧，算了...走吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Just deliver this big lunchbox to Panna who's out on a cave patrol.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
只要把這個大午餐盒送到正在洞穴巡邏的潘娜那裡就行了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我回來了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I said I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我說我回來了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我回來了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Good job. While the three of you went to the cave, Legalas visited with kaluna. If we can keep this up every day, delivery will be no problem at all.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
幹得好。你們三人去洞穴的時候，萊加拉斯帶著卡盧納來了。如果我們每天都能保持這樣，送貨就完全沒問題了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Adventurer, I'm counting on you tomorrow as well.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
冒險者，明天也拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
If time permits, I'll be out early and waiting.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
如果時間允許的話，我會早點出門等著。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
M-me, too?

[Gopara]
What were we called before?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我們之前叫什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
One!
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
一！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Team!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
隊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
One team. If I don't show up, they'll probably harass Legalas again. Fine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一隊。如果我不出現，他們大概又會去糾纏萊加拉斯了。好吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Okay, give me food now.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
好了，現在給我食物。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I'm fine. Had too much kalunyak that I'm still digesting.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我沒事。吃了太多卡盧尼亞克，現在還在消化。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You should take this. Nice work.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
你應該收下這個。幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Good job today as well. Two of you, get some food. Adventurer, that this. I'm counting on you tomorrow as well!
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
今天也幹得好。你們兩個，吃點東西吧。冒險者，拿著這個。明天也拜託你了！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Just deliver this big lunchbox to Panna who's out on a cave patrol.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
只要把這個大午餐盒送到正在洞穴巡邏的潘娜那裡就行了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Adventurer, you're here already? It's not the time for lunchbox delivery yet.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
冒險者，你來得這麼早？現在還不是送午餐盒的時間。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Right. Timing is off.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
沒錯。時間不對。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Timing is off!
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
時間不對！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Come back after the daybreak.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
請在天亮後再來。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
再見。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Right on time. Two people are here already and waiting.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
準時。已經有兩個人在這裡等著了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Yes, we've been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
是的，我們一直在等。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Waited for a long time. Almost died waiting.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
等了好久。都快等死了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Then I ask that you ^0000cddeliver the lunchbox to Panna in the cave^000000 for today as well. Hurry up on your way there, but take your time on your way back.
scripts.translation:
[卡盧]
那麼，今天也請你們^0000cddeliver the lunchbox to Panna in the cave^000000。去的時候快一點，回來的時候慢慢走。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我們走。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Let's get going!
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我們出發吧！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Stop eating! Stop! Shame on you!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
別吃了！停下！真丟人！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Enough already! You guys are getting worse and worse every day! don't you guys think this is too much? Have you no conscience?!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
夠了！你們一天比一天過分！難道不覺得這樣太過分了嗎？你們沒有良心嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Conscience? Mm... Sorry, but I don't know because I have no clue where my conscience is.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
良心？嗯...抱歉，我不知道，因為我根本不知道我的良心在哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Probably in the chest, right? But what am I supposed to do with it?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
大概是在胸口吧？但我該怎麼用它呢？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
The minute I catch kalunyak, you two devour it! You even ate the ones I had cleaned!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
我每次抓到卡魯尼亞克，你們倆就把它吃光！連我清理好的都吃了！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
didn't I tell you several times that those must be fermented and delivered? And the deadline has already passed!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
我不是告訴過你們好幾次嗎？那些必須發酵後送去！而且截止日期已經過了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Really? I didn't know.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
真的嗎？我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I did. But I couldn't help it.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我知道。但我忍不住。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh, are you Legalas who supplies kaluna?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，你是供應卡魯納的萊加拉斯嗎？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Now look! Someone is here because I couldn't make the delivery! I'm ruined now! I'll starve to death!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
你看！因為沒完成送貨，有人來了！我完蛋了！我要餓死了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. The situation is bad but no need to be so pessimistic. Why is everyone here so extreme?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷靜點。情況雖然糟糕，但不必這麼悲觀。為什麼這裡的人都這麼極端？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
I don't know what you mean. Please explain.
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
我不明白你的意思。請解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kalu from the adventurers' club wants to know why the delivery is being late. He has enough to sell for today, so everything will be fine as long as you can deliver by today.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冒險者俱樂部的卡盧想知道為什麼送貨晚了。他今天的貨已經賣完了，所以只要今天能送到就沒事。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Ha! Huh! Ha! I wish I can do that. But those two pigs are devouring the kalunyaks! At first, they ate one or two, but now they're at it the minute I catch one. I don't have the opportunity to clean and ferment it!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
哈！哼！哈！我真希望能那樣。但那兩頭豬把卡魯尼亞克都吃光了！起初，他們吃一兩個，但現在我一抓到就吃。我沒有機會清理和發酵！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
If you want kaluna, then do something about ^0000cdthose two over there^000000! I'm about to go crazy because not only do they leech onto me, now they're ruining my work. Perhaps It's better that I go back to the battlefield!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
如果你想要卡魯納，就去處理^0000cd那邊那兩個人^000000！我快瘋了，因為他們不僅白吃白喝，還毀了我的工作。也許我最好回戰場去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please calm down. I'll talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
請冷靜。我會跟他們談談。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
They won't listen no matter what. Look at those bellies. They're from eating so much kalunyak and kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
不管說什麼他們都不聽。看看他們的肚子。那是吃了太多卡魯尼亞克和卡魯納的結果。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Who knows where the pigs suddenly disappeared to, but I hope they're not back anytime soon. I'm on a roll here! A little more, just a little more...!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
誰知道那些豬突然跑哪去了，但我希望它們別這麼快就回來。我現在的狀態正佳！再努力一點，就快完成了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Legalas, I tried everything to make them work, but they have neither the skills nor will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
萊加拉斯，我試遍了所有辦法想讓他們幹活，但他們既沒技術也沒意願。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But they promised that they won't eat kalunyak, so you won't have any problem with the delivery anymore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過他們保證不再吃卡魯尼亞克了，所以你的送貨問題應該不會再出現了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You seem to have some grudge against us. I'm going to tell Legalas everything as soon as he gets here.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你好像對我們很有意見。等萊加拉斯來了，我會把一切都告訴他。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What did we do wrong anyway?
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我們到底做錯了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
I was wondering why you suddenly took these two out. So That's what happened. It must've been difficult, taking them around with you.
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
我正納悶你為什麼要突然帶這兩個人出來。原來是這樣。帶著他們到處跑一定很辛苦吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Thanks to your sacrifice, I was able to make most of the ^0000cdkaluna^000000 I needed to deliver. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
多虧了你的犧牲，我才能做出大部分需要交付的^0000cd卡魯納^000000。非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You guys are openly being mean to us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你們明明就是在故意刁難我們。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Kalunyak is definitely the best.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
卡魯尼亞克絕對是最好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Doh! That pig is eating kalunyak again!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
天哪！那頭豬又在吃卡魯尼亞克了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I was hungry. I can't eat anchovies anymore. I can only eat kalunyak now.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我餓了。我再也吃不下鳳尾魚了，現在只能吃卡魯尼亞克。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I have no work so I'll eat again.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我沒事做，那就再吃點吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Adventurer, I have a favor to ask. I haven't met my delivery quota yet, but those two are eating all my kalunyaks! What you see is all I got for today and at this rate, I won't be able to fulfill the order.
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
冒險者，我有件事想拜託你。我還沒完成今天的送貨配額，但那兩個人把我的卡魯尼亞克都吃光了！這就是我今天剩下的全部了，照這個速度下去，我沒法完成訂單。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Please take them with you again, even for a short while!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
求你了，哪怕只是一小會兒，也請把他們帶走吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to deliver some message to Kalu anyway, so I'll take the two with me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
反正我也得給卡盧送個訊息，我就帶他們一起去吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Please, I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
拜託了，求求你了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys, how about we go to the ^0000cdPub-Oven^000000?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家，我們要不去^0000cdPub-Oven^000000？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Fine. Anywhere as long as It's not boring.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
行吧。只要不無聊，去哪都行。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Does it have plenty of yummy food? If yes, I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
那裡有很多好吃的嗎？有的話我就去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's go then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我們走吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Thanks for keeping these pigs. Thanks to you, my job got easier!
scripts.translation:
[萊加拉斯]
謝謝你們照顧這些豬。多虧了你們，我的工作輕鬆多了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys, there's something I wish to share with you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家，我有件事想告訴你們。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm getting tired of this now. But there's nothing else to eat.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我現在有點膩了。但也沒別的可吃的了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
When did we eat because we wanted to? It was more like eating because it was there.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我們什麼時候是“想吃”才吃的？明明是因為“有”才吃的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys?

[Daldal]
What is it? Did you bring something to eat?
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
怎麼了？你帶了吃的來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Are you going to play with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你要跟我們玩嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
From what I hear, you eat all the kalunyaks that Legalas cleans. Right now, we're almost out of kaluna made from those kalunyaks. Can you please control yourselves a bit?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽說，你們把萊加拉斯清理的卡魯尼亞克全吃光了。現在，用那些卡魯尼亞克做的卡魯納快用完了。請你們稍微克制一下好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Why should we?
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
為什麼要剋制？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because you can't make kaluna milk without kaluna. Someone who was supposed to receive kaluna from Legalas is in a tight spot right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
因為沒有卡魯尼亞克就做不出卡魯納奶。有個本該從萊加拉斯那裡拿到卡魯納的人，現在正陷入困境。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What does that have to do with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那跟我們有什麼關係？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You see, Kalu really needs kaluna. Without kaluna, he can't continue his business.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看，卡盧真的很需要卡魯納。沒有卡魯納，他就沒法繼續做生意了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That has nothing to do with me.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
那跟我沒關係。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It has a lot to do with Legalas. You are aware that Legalas supplies Kalu with kaluna fermented from kalunyak, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但這跟萊加拉斯關係很大。你們知道萊加拉斯是用卡魯尼亞克發酵成卡魯納，供應給卡盧的吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If he can't meet the deadline or delivery quota, he'll lose his job to someone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果他無法按時交貨或達到配額，他的工作就會被別人取代。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
So what does that have to do with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那又怎樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If Legalas loses his job, then he won't be able to earn money. And if he can't earn money, then wouldn't that put you guys in a tight spot?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果萊加拉斯丟了工作，他就賺不到錢。如果他賺不到錢，你們不也會陷入困境嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
From what I gather, Legalas feeds you, clothes you, and puts a roof over your heads.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
據我瞭解，是萊加拉斯給你們提供食物、衣物，並給你們一個棲身之所。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
We don't wear clothes.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我們不穿衣服。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Then Legalas can find some other job.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那萊加拉斯可以去找別的工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you're ruining his work right now, what makes you think that Legalas won't do anything later? He'll probably get rid of you two and go find some other opportunities.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果你現在正在破壞他的工作，你怎麼能認為萊加拉斯之後不會採取任何行動呢？他可能會把你們兩個趕走，然後去尋找其他的機會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then you two who can't support yourselves will wander around and starve to death in some filthy backstreet alley.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
然後你們兩個無法養活自己的人，就會在某個骯髒的後街巷子裡流浪，直到餓死。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
N-no way!
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
不...不會的！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
T-That's too extreme!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那...那太誇張了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then you guys shouldn't get in the way now, should you? Are you going to eat more kalunyaks?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼你們現在就不應該搗亂，對吧？你們還要再吃些卡魯尼亞克嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
No! No more!
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
不！不吃了！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Not eating kalunyaks is not enough. I've never thought about the possibility that Legalas can leave us. We must do something.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
不吃卡魯尼亞克是不夠的。我從未想過萊加拉斯可能會離開我們。我們必須做點什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great attitude! Now Legalas will...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
態度很好！那麼萊加拉斯將會...

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Now, teach us.
scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:

there's a baby here.

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

[Workshop Manager]

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I don't think I can eat another anchovy ever again. Our eyes met just before. They're going to follow me every time I see an anchovy.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我想我再也不會吃鯷魚了。剛才我和它四目相對。以後每次看到鯷魚，我都會想起那雙眼睛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ha... Is that so? Seems like this job is not for you either. Then Let's go find something else. Was there any other job you wanted to try?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈...是嗎？看來這份工作也不適合你們。那我們去別的地方找找吧。還有沒有其他想嘗試的工作？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Ship. I want to be on a ^0000cdship^000000!
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
船。我想上^0000cd船^000000！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Right. I've been living in Lasagna all this time and never been on a ship. This is a good chance to board on one.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
沒錯。我一直住在羅札納，卻從未上過船。這是個登船的好機會。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah? Then Let's go to that ^0000cdanchovy fishing boat up there^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是嗎？那我們去上面那艘^0000cd鯷魚漁船^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Didn't you say you were going to the anchovy shipping boat? Beats me what you can do there even if you go there.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理員]
你們不是說要去鯷魚運輸船嗎？就算去了，我也不知道你們能在那裡做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Lasagna's anchovies are special. Top quality anchovies are steamed and dried nine times, followed by removal of head and guts. This is an art work that requires delicate processes.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理員]
羅札納的鯷魚很特別。頂級的鯷魚要經過九次蒸乾，然後去頭去內臟。這是一門需要精細工序的藝術。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
They're perfect to be served with alcohol and make great snacks for students studying for an exam. Try one.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理員]
它們非常適合下酒，也是備考學生的絕佳零食。嚐嚐看。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I've always wanted to be on a boat... hah... nostalgia...
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我一直想上船...哈哈...懷舊...

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Every time I see a boat, it reminds me of a shell. You know, the one that is empty inside and hard outside.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
每次看到船，都會讓我想起貝殼。
就是那種裡面是空的，外面卻很硬的東西。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
What is it?
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
什麼事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was wondering if you need any help on the ship.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我在想，船上是否需要人手幫忙。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Anchovy business has definitely seen better days, but I'm always short on hands.
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
鯷魚生意雖然不如從前，但我總是缺人手。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then how about you give these two a try? They want to work on a ship, so even an apprenticeship would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那您不妨試試這兩個人？他們想在船上工作，所以即使是當學徒也不錯。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Feels like we're being sold.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
感覺我們要被賣掉了一樣。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Probably just an imagination. He wouldn't sell us.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
大概只是錯覺吧。他不會賣我們的。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Hey, you two over there. Have you ever been on a ship?
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
嘿，你們兩個。以前上過船嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Nope.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
沒有。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Nah. My mom held my hand and came here just by riding on the tides. She was swept away and I landed here alone. Legalas found me and since then, we've been living together like a family.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
沒有。我媽媽牽著我的手，只是順著潮汐漂到了這裡。她被沖走了，而我獨自漂到了這裡。萊加拉斯發現了我，從那以後，我們就像家人一樣生活在一起。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
No need to know about your past. I just need you to do a good job on the ship. Since this is the first time on a boat for both of you, looks like there's a long bumpy road ahead.
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
不需要了解你們的過去，我只需要你們在船上好好工作。既然你們倆都是第一次上船，看來前面的路會很難走啊。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
So mean. I shared my painful past and you couldn't care any less.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
好冷漠。我分享了痛苦的過去，你卻毫不在意。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
It's okay. I care.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
沒關係。我在意。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I want to share mine. Can I tell you?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我想分享我的故事。我可以告訴你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Not really interested.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
不太感興趣。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's fight!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我們來打一架吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now now, calm down. How does it feel to be on a ship? It carries anchovies from the anchovy fishing boat to Lasagna, but you won't get to see them since the cargo is stored in the storage area.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了好了，冷靜點。在船上感覺如何？這艘船將鯷魚從鯷魚漁船運送到羅札納，但你們看不到它們，因為貨物存放在倉庫裡。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That's not the problem I'm upset.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我生氣的原因不是這個。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Why does the floor look so nauseous?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
為什麼地板看起來這麼讓人噁心？

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Looks like you got a seasickness. It'll get better after a while. By then, you'll feel strange when you walk on land.
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
看來你暈船了。過一會兒就會好起來的。到時候，你在陸地上走路可能會覺得有點奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Weird. The ship is firm, but why is it so nauseous?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
奇怪。船很穩固，為什麼我會這麼噁心？

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
That's because the boat moves along with the waves.
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
那是因為船會隨著波浪起伏。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What? Isn't the boat stuck firmly on the water?!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
什麼？船不是牢牢地停在水面上嗎？！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
It's floating on water, not stuck on water. How can a boat move if It's stuck on water?!
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
它是浮在水面上，不是停在水面上。如果船停在水面上，它怎麼動得了？！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I can't believe it! How can you say that such heavy boat is floating on water?!
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
難以置信！你怎麼能說這麼重的船是浮在水面上的？！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Hey you, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
喂，冒險者！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Take them back with you. Working on a ship doesn't require high intelligence, but these idiots probably can't even pull off a cleaning job. No, forget cleaning. I'll be lucky if they don't drive me crazy first.
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
把他們帶回去吧。在船上工作不需要高智商，但這幾個笨蛋可能連打掃衛生都做不好。不，別說打掃衛生了。要是他們先把我逼瘋，那才是我的幸運。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What do you mean you understand? You don't say such a thing like that.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你說你明白了是什麼意思？你不能這麼說。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This won't do. I don't think I can help you. We should go back to ^0000cdLegalas^000000 discuss the matter with him. Let's go now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這樣不行。我覺得我幫不了你們。我們應該回到^0000cd萊加拉斯^000000那裡和他商量一下。我們現在就走吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I don't know what just happened, but I'm happy to go back.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我不知道剛才發生了什麼，但我很高興能回去。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Yeah, Let's go back for now. This is not fun anymore.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
是啊，我們先回去吧。這裡一點也不好玩。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Didn't you say that you're going back to Legalas? And next time you bring some helpers, make sure they're decent.
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
你不是說你要回萊加拉斯那裡嗎？下次你再帶助手來的時候，確保他們靠譜一點。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
If you have anybody decent, bring him. I'm so short on hands that I do all of that work by myself.
scripts.translation:
鯷魚漁船船長
如果你有任何靠譜的人，就帶他來。我人手嚴重不足，所有工作都只能自己幹。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What is it? didn't you say that you had some business with not me, but Kalu?
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
怎麼了？你不是說你有事要找卡盧，而不是我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Kalu! Tell Kalu that you delivered the lunchbox so we can eat!
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
卡盧！告訴卡盧你已經把午餐盒送來了，這樣我們就可以吃飯了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I like relaxing here as well. No craving for kalunyak either.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我也喜歡在這裡放鬆。我也沒有特別想吃卡盧尼亞克。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Didn't you say you had something to say to Kalu? Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你不是說你有話要對卡盧說嗎？說吧。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Too late. Go and report to Kalu.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
太遲了。快去告訴卡盧。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You're here already. We hate waiting, so we're thinking about just settling here.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你終於來了。我們討厭等待，所以正打算直接在這裡安頓下來。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Hurry, go and deliver his lunchbox. He looks like he's about to starve to death.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
快一點，去送他的午餐盒。他看起來快要餓死了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Give that vigilante a lunchbox. I'm curious as to what's inside.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
給那個義警送個午餐盒。我很好奇裡面裝的是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Oh, I'm so hungry. When is the food coming? Food.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
啊，我好餓。飯什麼時候來？我要吃飯。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Panna?

[{0}]
Panna? Here's your lunchbox...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
潘娜？這是你的午餐盒...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Where's the lunchbox? Where's mine? there's none for me! Where did you drop it? My food! My food!!!
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
午餐盒在哪裡？我的呢？沒有我的份！你把它掉哪裡了？我的食物！我的食物！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. I'll go find it right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷靜點。我現在就去找。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
He lost his mind.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
他瘋了吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I can understand, though. Let's go find the lunchbox.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
雖然能理解，但讓我們去找午餐盒吧。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Food!!!
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
食物！！！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What a rude, ungrateful doram.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
真是個粗魯、不知感恩的多蘭。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
How am I supposed to talk when I'm eating?
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我在吃東西的時候怎麼說話？

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Chomp chomp chomp.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That looks delicious...
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
看起來很好吃...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Hah, I feel much better now. I was so hungry that I was about to eat a basilisk, and you couldn't come at a better time. I almost became a doram who failed to remain as one and turn into an animal.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
哈，我現在感覺好多了。剛才餓得差點吃了基拉肯，你來得真是時候。我差點變成一個沒能保持理智而變成野獸的多蘭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll take the empty dishes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把空盤子收走。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
It's okay, just leave them. I'll take them with me when I go back to town later.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
沒關係，就留在這裡吧。我稍後回城鎮時會帶走的。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I'm going.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我走了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm leaving.
scripts.translation:
[達爾達爾]
我要走了。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Thanks to you, I was able to eat a hearty meal. Please tell Kalu that I'm grateful for the delicious lunch. Hopefully, today will be another safe...
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
多虧了你，我才能吃上一頓飽飯。請告訴卡盧，我很感謝這頓美味的午餐。希望今天也能平安無事...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Oh, I'm so hungry. When is the food coming? Food.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
啊，我好餓。飯什麼時候來？我要吃飯。
